+func pathUnder(path,dir string) bool {path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));dir=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(dir)),"/");return strings.HasPrefix(path,dir+"/")}
+func matchAny(globs []string,path string) bool {for _,g:=range globs {if contracts.MatchGlob(g,path){return true}};return false}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev==""{return false};_,err:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,rev,path);return err==nil}
+func Zones(req model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {
+ var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module {target=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+ bad:=[]project.Diagnostic{};reject:=func(path,reason string){bad=append(bad,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:reason})}
+ check:=func(path string,src bool) {if path=="" {return};path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));if path==req.ChangePath {return}
+  if pathUnder(path,"changes") {reject(path,"other change file");return}
+  if pathUnder(path,".fireweed")||matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path) {reject(path,"protected path");return}
+  for _,m:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if path==m.Dir+"/SPEC.md" {reject(path,"module SPEC.md");return};if pathUnder(path,m.Dir)&&m.Name!=req.Module {reject(path,"another module");return}}
+  if req.Phase=="audit" {reject(path,"audit permits only current change");return}

+   case "protected":reject(path,"protected zone")
+   case "evals":if req.Phase!="evals" {reject(path,"evals zone")}
+   case "interface":if req.Phase!="evals"||!req.InterfaceDeclared {reject(path,"interface zone")}
+   case "append_only":if req.Phase!="impl"||src||existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path) {reject(path,"append_only zone")}
+   case "disposable":if req.Phase=="evals"&&(src||existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path)){reject(path,"existing disposable file")}
+   case "preserve":if req.Phase=="evals" {reject(path,"preserve zone")}
+   }

+  }

+ }

func Test_CHK_074_HistoryAuthorAppendOnlyModifyDeleteRename(t *testing.T) {
	for _, action := range []string{"modify", "delete", "rename"} {
		t.Run(action, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newHistoryFixture(t)
			path := "packages/alpha/ledger/entry.txt"
			switch action {
			case "modify":
				f.put(path, "modified\n")
			case "delete":
				f.remove(path)
			case "rename":
				f.move(path, "packages/alpha/ledger/renamed.txt")
			}
			commit := f.commit("human maintenance")
			got := f.report(f.base + "..HEAD")
			if len(got.Diagnostics) == 0 {
				t.Errorf("%s diagnostics = %#v; want H03", action, got.Diagnostics)
			}
			for _, d := range got.Diagnostics {
				if d.Code != "H03" || !strings.Contains(d.Message, commit) || (d.Path != path && d.Path != "packages/alpha/ledger/renamed.txt") {
					t.Errorf("%s unexpected diagnostic %#v", action, d)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func Test_CHK_074_HistoryMergeResolutionInMergeOnlyRange(t *testing.T) {
	f := newHistoryFixture(t)
	f.git("checkout", "-qb", "side")
	f.put("packages/alpha/ledger/entry.txt", "side\n")
	f.commit("side edits ledger")
	f.git("checkout", "-q", "main")
	f.put("packages/alpha/ledger/entry.txt", "main\n")
	f.commit("main edits ledger")
	result, err := gitstore.Run(context.Background(), gitstore.Request{Args: []string{"git", "-C", f.root, "merge", "--no-ff", "--no-commit", "side"}, Dir: f.root})
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(result.Stdout+result.Stderr, "CONFLICT") {
		t.Fatalf("expected ordinary merge conflict, got %v: %s %s", err, result.Stdout, result.Stderr)
	}
	f.put("packages/alpha/ledger/entry.txt", "resolved uniquely\n")
	merge := f.commit("resolve conflict")
	got := f.report(merge + "^!")
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got.Commits, []string{merge}) {
		t.Errorf("merge-only selection = %#v; want [%s]", got.Commits, merge)
	}
	expectHistoryFindings(t, got, historyFinding{"H03", "packages/alpha/ledger/entry.txt", merge})
}

func Test_CHK_076_HistoryMultipleSquashedChangesKeepH03H04(t *testing.T) {
	f := newHistoryFixture(t)
	archiveOld := "changes/archive/0000-old.md"
	f.change(archiveOld, "applied", "")
	archiveBaseline := f.commit("existing archive")
	for _, path := range []string{"changes/archive/0001-one.md", "changes/archive/0002-two.md"} {
		f.change(path, "applied", "")
	}
	f.put("locked/config.txt", "squash protection\n")
	f.put("packages/alpha/evals/existing_test.go", "squash eval\n")
	f.put("packages/alpha/ledger/entry.txt", "squash ledger\n")
	f.put(archiveOld, "---\nmodule: alpha\nphase: applied\n---\n\nChanged old archive.\n")
	squash := f.commit("squashed changes")
	got := f.report(archiveBaseline + "..HEAD")
	wantSquashed := map[checks.SquashedChange]bool{
		{Commit: squash, Change: "changes/archive/0001-one.md"}: true,
		{Commit: squash, Change: "changes/archive/0002-two.md"}: true,
	}
	if len(got.Squashed) != len(wantSquashed) {
		t.Errorf("squashed = %#v; want %#v", got.Squashed, wantSquashed)
	} else {
		for _, entry := range got.Squashed {
			if !wantSquashed[entry] {
				t.Errorf("unexpected squashed entry %#v; want %#v", entry, wantSquashed)
			}
			delete(wantSquashed, entry)
		}
		if len(wantSquashed) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("missing squashed entries %#v", wantSquashed)
		}
	}
	expectHistoryFindings(t, got,
		historyFinding{"H03", "packages/alpha/ledger/entry.txt", squash},
		historyFinding{"H04", archiveOld, squash})
}

func Test_CHK_078_HistoryRejectsUnreadableRangeAndRecordedDocuments(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name       string
		edit       func(historyFixture)
		rangeValue string
	}{
		{"invalid_range", nil, "missing-ref..HEAD"},
		{"missing_config", func(f historyFixture) { f.remove("fireweed.yaml") }, ""},
		{"malformed_config", func(f historyFixture) { f.put("fireweed.yaml", "modules: [broken\n") }, ""},
		{"missing_SPEC", func(f historyFixture) { f.remove("packages/alpha/SPEC.md") }, ""},
		{"malformed_change", func(f historyFixture) { f.put("changes/0001-work.md", "---\nmodule: [broken\n---\n") }, ""},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newHistoryFixture(t)
			if tc.edit != nil {
				tc.edit(f)
				f.commit("record invalid input")
			}
			revisionRange := tc.rangeValue
			if revisionRange == "" {
				revisionRange = f.base + "..HEAD"
			}
			if _, err := checks.History(f.root, revisionRange); err == nil {
				t.Errorf("History(%q) accepted %s", revisionRange, tc.name)
			}
		})
	}
}

+ raw,e:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--topo-order","--reverse",revisionRange);if e!=nil{return result,e};if raw==""{return result,nil};result.Commits=strings.Split(raw,"\n")
+ for _,oid:=range result.Commits {parentLine,e:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--parents","-n","1",oid);if e!=nil{return result,e};fields:=strings.Fields(parentLine);parents:=fields[1:];before:="";if len(parents)>0 {before=parents[0]}
+  afterSnap,e:=project.LoadAt(root,oid);if e!=nil{return result,e};var beforeSnap project.Snapshot;if before!=""{beforeSnap,e=project.LoadAt(root,before);if e!=nil{return result,e}}
+  beforeChanges,e:=changeStates(root,before);if e!=nil{return result,e};afterChanges,e:=changeStates(root,oid);if e!=nil{return result,e}
+  parentStates:=[]map[string]struct{path,phase,module string}{};for _,p:=range parents {states,e:=changeStates(root,p);if e!=nil{return result,e};parentStates=append(parentStates,states)}
+  worker:=false;applied:=false;squashed:=false;workerModule:="";projected:=afterSnap
+  for name,state:=range afterChanges {newPhase:=true;hadImpl:=false;for _,p:=range parentStates {if previous,ok:=p[name];ok {if previous.phase==state.phase{newPhase=false};if previous.phase=="impl"{hadImpl=true}}};if !newPhase{continue};if state.phase=="audit"||state.phase=="evals"||state.phase=="impl"||state.phase=="applied"{worker=true;workerModule=state.module};if state.phase=="applied" {applied=true;if !hadImpl {squashed=true;result.Squashed=append(result.Squashed,model.SquashedChange{Commit:oid,Change:state.path})}}}
+  _=beforeChanges
+  ds,e:=deltas(root,before,oid,len(parents)>1);if e!=nil{return result,e};if len(parents)>1 {for _,p:=range parents {extra,e:=deltas(root,p,oid,false);if e!=nil{return result,e};for _,d:=range extra {if zoneIn(beforeSnap,d.path,"append_only")||zoneIn(afterSnap,d.path,"append_only"){ds=append(ds,d)}}}}
+  seen:=map[string]bool{};add:=func(code,path string){key:=code+"|"+path;if seen[key]{return};seen[key]=true;result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s in commit %s",code,oid)})}
+  for _,d:=range ds {paths:=[]string{d.path};if d.old!="" {paths=append(paths,d.old)};for _,path:=range paths {if path==""{continue};if worker&&!squashed {if strings.HasPrefix(path,".fireweed/playbooks/")||matchAny(stringsValue(beforeSnap.Config["protected"]),path)||matchAny(stringsValue(afterSnap.Config["protected"]),path){add("H01",path)};if applied {m:=findModule(projected,path);if m!=nil&&m.Name==workerModule&&(zoneIn(beforeSnap,path,"evals")||zoneIn(beforeSnap,path,"interface")||zoneIn(projected,path,"evals")||zoneIn(projected,path,"interface")){add("H02",path)}}}
+    if (zoneIn(beforeSnap,path,"append_only")||zoneIn(afterSnap,path,"append_only"))&&(d.status!="A") {add("H03",path)}
+    if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/archive/")&&d.status!="A"&&d.status!="D"&&path==d.path{add("H04",path)}
+   }}
+ }

+}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module)([]contracts.Item,error){body,ok:=contracts.Section(m.Document.Body,"Specs");if !ok{return nil,nil};items,err:=contracts.ParseItems(body);if err!=nil {msg:=err.Error();if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(msg),"duplicate") {return nil,coded("C05","%s",msg)};return nil,coded("C03","%s",msg)};return items,nil}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, req model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+ var m *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module {m=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}};if m==nil{return model.Report{},coded("U02","unknown module %q",req.Module)}
+ specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*m);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+ h:=moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter,"eval");if h==nil {h=hook(req.Snapshot.Config,"eval")};if h==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",m.Name)}
+ c,err:=parseCommand(h);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","%v",err)}
+ f,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};reportPath:=f.Name();f.Close();os.Remove(reportPath);defer os.Remove(reportPath)
+ values:=map[string]string{"module":m.Name,"module_dir":m.Dir,"report":reportPath};c=c.expanded(values)
+ r:=runCommand(ctx,c,req.Snapshot.Root,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":req.Bin},req.Timeout)
+ report:=model.Report{HookExit:r.exit,Stdout:r.stdout,Stderr:r.stderr}
+ if r.err!=nil {var exit *os.PathError;var ex interface{ ExitCode() int };if errors.As(r.err,&exit)||!errors.As(r.err,&ex){return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",r.err)}}
+ data,err:=os.ReadFile(reportPath);if err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","read JUnit report: %v",err)}
+ parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+ failed:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"{failed=true;break}}
+ if (r.exit==0)==failed {return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",r.exit)}
+ return report,nil
+}
+
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context,req model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+ snap:=req.Snapshot;diags:=[]project.Diagnostic{};var causes []error
+ baseline:=map[string]bool{};if data,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root,".fireweed","boundaries-baseline"));e==nil {for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(data),"\n") {if line!="" {baseline[line]=true}}}
+ global:=hook(snap.Config,"boundaries")
+ run:=func(label string,h any){c,e:=parseCommand(h);if e!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:label+": "+e.Error()});causes=append(causes,e);return};r:=runCommand(ctx,c.expanded(map[string]string{}),snap.Root,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":req.Bin},req.Timeout);if r.err!=nil {var ex interface{ExitCode()int};if !errors.As(r.err,&ex)||ctx.Err()!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:label+": "+r.err.Error()});causes=append(causes,r.err);return}}
+  for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr,"\n"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line==""||baseline[line] {continue};suppressed:=false;for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);if reason!=""&&strings.HasPrefix(line,m.Name+":") {suppressed=true;break}};if suppressed{continue};diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X01",Message:line});causes=append(causes,fmt.Errorf("%s",line))}
+ }
+ if global!=nil {run("global boundaries hook",global)}
+ for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);if reason!="" {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X03",Message:m.Name+": boundaries opt out: "+reason,Warning:true})}
+  override:=moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter,"boundaries");if override!=nil {run(m.Name+" boundaries hook",override)} else if global==nil {if len(m.Zones.Disposable)>0&&reason=="" {msg:=m.Name+": missing boundaries hook";diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:msg});causes=append(causes,errors.New(msg))} else {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X04",Message:m.Name+": no boundary enforcement required",Warning:true})}}
+ }
+ return diags,errors.Join(causes...)
+}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "encoding/xml"
+ "fmt"
+ "io"
+ "regexp"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitCase struct { Name string `xml:"name,attr"`; Classname string `xml:"classname,attr"`; Time string `xml:"time,attr"`; Failure []junitProblem `xml:"failure"`; Error []junitProblem `xml:"error"`; Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"` }
+type junitProblem struct { Message string `xml:"message,attr"`; Body string `xml:",chardata"` }
+var specToken=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(^|[^a-z0-9])([a-z]+[-_]?[0-9]{3,})([^0-9]|$)`)
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte,specs []contracts.Item)(model.Report,error){
+ dec:=xml.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)));root,err:=dec.Token();if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+ start,ok:=root.(xml.StartElement);if !ok || (start.Name.Local!="testsuite"&&start.Name.Local!="testsuites") {name:="";if ok{name=start.Name.Local};return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",name)}
+ report:=model.Report{Cases:[]model.Case{}};depth:=1
+ for depth>0 {tok,e:=dec.Token();if e!=nil {if e==io.EOF {return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: unexpected EOF")};return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",e)}
+  switch v:=tok.(type){case xml.StartElement:depth++;if v.Name.Local!="testcase" {continue};var raw junitCase;if e:=dec.DecodeElement(&raw,&v);e!=nil{return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",e)};depth--
+   c:=model.Case{Name:raw.Name,Classname:raw.Classname,Result:"pass"};if raw.Time!="" {c.Seconds,_=strconv.ParseFloat(raw.Time,64)}
+   if len(raw.Skipped)>0 {c.Result="skip"};if len(raw.Failure)>0||len(raw.Error)>0 {c.Result="fail";parts:=[]string{};for _,p:=range append(raw.Failure,raw.Error...) {if s:=strings.TrimSpace(p.Message);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)};if s:=strings.TrimSpace(p.Body);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)}};c.Failure=strings.Join(parts,"\n")}
+   for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname){c.IDs=append(c.IDs,s.ID)}}
+   if len(c.IDs)==0 {for _,candidate:=range []string{c.Name,c.Classname} {for _,m:=range specToken.FindAllStringSubmatch(candidate,-1) {id:=strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(m[2],"_","-"));for _,s:=range specs {prefix:=strings.SplitN(strings.ToUpper(s.ID),"-",2)[0];if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ReplaceAll(id,"-",""),prefix) {return report,coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,m[2])}}}};return report,coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)}
+   report.Seconds+=c.Seconds;report.Cases=append(report.Cases,c)
+  case xml.EndElement:depth--}
+ }
+ if _,e:=dec.Token();e!=io.EOF {if e!=nil{return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",e)};return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: trailing XML")}
+ return report,nil
+}
+func hasID(ids []string,id string)bool{for _,x:=range ids{if x==id{return true}};return false}
+func exemptTag(tag string)bool {s:=strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag));return strings.HasPrefix(s,"review")||strings.HasPrefix(s,"quarantine")}
+func RequireCoverage(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error{for _,s:=range specs {if exemptTag(s.Tag){continue};found:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases {if c.Result!="skip"&&hasID(c.IDs,s.ID){found=true;break}};if !found{return coded("C10","no coverage for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func RequireFailFirst(report model.Report,ids,already []string)error{for _,id:=range ids {if hasID(already,id){continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"&&hasID(c.IDs,id){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("P2-01","no fail-first case for %s",id)}};return nil}
+func RequirePass(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error{for _,c:=range report.Cases {if c.Result!="fail" {continue};for _,id:=range c.IDs {for _,s:=range specs {if s.ID==id&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(s.Tag),"quarantine") {return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s",c.Name,id)}}}};return nil}
+var _=fmt.Sprintf

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4c29719381b13663aee4e77a5fee9ee4baf17662
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func pathUnder(path,dir string) bool {path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));dir=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(dir)),"/");return strings.HasPrefix(path,dir+"/")}
+func matchAny(globs []string,path string) bool {for _,g:=range globs {if contracts.MatchGlob(g,path){return true}};return false}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev==""{return false};_,err:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,rev,path);return err==nil}
+func Zones(req model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {
+ var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module {target=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+ bad:=[]project.Diagnostic{};reject:=func(path,reason string){bad=append(bad,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:reason})}
+ check:=func(path string,src bool) {if path=="" {return};path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));if path==req.ChangePath {return}
+  if pathUnder(path,"changes") {reject(path,"other change file");return}
+  if pathUnder(path,".fireweed")||matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path) {reject(path,"protected path");return}
+  for _,m:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if path==m.Dir+"/SPEC.md" {reject(path,"module SPEC.md");return};if pathUnder(path,m.Dir)&&m.Name!=req.Module {reject(path,"another module");return}}
+  if req.Phase=="audit" {reject(path,"audit permits only current change");return}
+  if target!=nil&&pathUnder(path,target.Dir) {rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(target.Dir,"/")+"/");zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones);switch zone {
+   case "protected":reject(path,"protected zone")
+   case "evals":if req.Phase!="evals" {reject(path,"evals zone")}
+   case "interface":if req.Phase!="evals"||!req.InterfaceDeclared {reject(path,"interface zone")}
+   case "append_only":if req.Phase!="impl"||src||existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path) {reject(path,"append_only zone")}
+   case "disposable":if req.Phase=="evals"&&(src||existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path)){reject(path,"existing disposable file")}
+   case "preserve":if req.Phase=="evals" {reject(path,"preserve zone")}
+   }
+   return
+  }
+  if !matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),path){reject(path,"outside worker_writable")}
+ }
+ for _,c:=range req.Changes {if c.OldPath!="" {check(c.OldPath,true)};check(c.Path,false)}
+ return bad
+}

func Test_CHK_051_CHK_052_SetupFailureStopsAndCleans(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put(".fireweed/setup.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'setup:%%s\\n' \"$PWD\" >> %q\necho failed setup >&2\nexit 17\n", f.log))
	f.commit()
	before := worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, "setup") {
		t.Errorf("setup failure absent: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "eval:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "boundaries:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "worker:") {
		t.Errorf("setup failure ran later probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("scratch worktree leaked: %q", got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
}

func Test_CHK_051_CancellationCleansScratchAndStopsSetupGroup(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	ready := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ready")
	childFinished := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "child-finished")
	f.put(".fireweed/setup.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/sh
printf 'setup:%%s\n' "$PWD" >> %q
sh -c 'sleep 2; printf finished > "$1"' sh %q &
printf ready > %q
wait
`, f.log, childFinished, ready))
	f.commit()
	before := worktrees(f)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	reports := make(chan checks.DoctorReport, 1)
	go func() { reports <- checks.Doctor(ctx, f.request(true)) }()
	deadline := time.After(8 * time.Second)
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(ready); err == nil {
			break
		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		select {
		case report := <-reports:
			t.Fatalf("setup exited before cancellation: %s", doctorText(report))
		case <-deadline:
			t.Fatal("setup never signalled readiness")
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
	cancel()
	select {
	case report := <-reports:
		if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, "setup") {
			t.Errorf("cancelled setup lacked C14: %s", doctorText(report))
		}
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("cancelled doctor did not return promptly")
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("cancelled doctor retained Git registration: before %q after %q", before, got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
	time.Sleep(2200 * time.Millisecond)
	if _, err := os.Stat(childFinished); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("cancelled setup descendant continued: %v", err)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_054_MissingTemplatesAndCanaryMaps(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, path, body, term, input, affected string }{
		{"missing template", ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "", "template", "SPEC.md", "undeclared"},
		{"malformed template", ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "---\nname: [broken\nid_prefix: {{prefix}}\n---\n", "template", "SPEC.md", "undeclared"},
		{"missing baseline", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: 1\nbaseline: {}\n", "canary", "baseline", "undeclared"},
		{"missing internal_eval", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "missing_id:\n  evals/missing.txt: missing\n", "internal_eval", "internal_eval", "internal_eval"},
		{"wrong version", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: 2\nbaseline: {}\n", "canary", "canaries.yaml", "undeclared"},
		{"malformed canary", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: [bad\n", "canary", "canaries.yaml", "undeclared"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			if tc.name == "missing baseline" {
				body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)))
				start, end := strings.Index(body, "baseline:\n"), strings.Index(body, "undeclared:\n")
				if start < 0 || end <= start {
					t.Fatal("fixture cannot isolate baseline map")
				}
				tc.body = body[:start] + "baseline: {}\n" + body[end:]
			}
			if tc.name == "missing internal_eval" {
				body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)))
				tc.body = strings.Replace(body, "internal_eval:\n  internal/private.txt: \"private\"\n  evals/internal.txt: \"{{module_dir}}\"\n", "", 1)
				if tc.body == body {
					t.Fatal("fixture did not remove internal_eval map")
				}
			}
			if tc.body == "" {
				if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			} else {
				f.put(tc.path, tc.body)
			}
			f.commit()
			report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, tc.term) {
				t.Errorf("missing C14: %s", doctorText(report))
			}
			identified := false
			for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
				if d.Code == "C14" && !d.Warning && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message+" "+d.Path), strings.ToLower(tc.input)) {
					identified = true
				}
			}
			if !identified {
				t.Errorf("C14 did not identify %s: %s", tc.input, doctorText(report))
			}
			if hasDoctorCheck(report, tc.affected, true) {
				t.Errorf("invalid recipe passed canary: %s", doctorText(report))
			}
		})
	}
}

func Test_CHK_055_CHK_056_CHK_057_CHK_058_CHK_059_ZeroHookAndRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put(".fireweed/boundary.sh", "#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n")
	f.put(".fireweed/eval.sh", `#!/bin/sh
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="ALP-001"/></testsuite>' > "$3"
`)
	f.commit()
	before := worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, hook string }{{"undeclared", "boundar"}, {"internal_eval", "boundar"}, {"failing_eval", "eval"}, {"missing_id", "eval"}} {
		if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, tc.name, tc.hook) {
			t.Errorf("missed %s canary not diagnosed with hook: %s", tc.name, doctorText(report))
		}
	}
	if !doctorErrors(report) {
		t.Errorf("zero hooks accepted: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("failed canary leaked worktree: %s", got)
	}

	g := localDoctorFixture(t)
	g.put(".fireweed/boundary.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/sh
find packages -name SPEC.md | while IFS= read -r spec; do
  dir=${spec%%/SPEC.md}; name=$(sed -n 's/^name: //p' "$spec" | head -1)

func Test_CHK_055_CHK_058_CHK_059_EvalEvidenceIsSpecific(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, script, canary string }{

printf '<testsuite/>' > "$3"
`, "baseline"},
		{"failing eval compile error without report", `#!/bin/sh

prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "failing_eval"},
		{"failing eval with unrelated failure", `#!/bin/sh
if test -f "$2/evals/failing.txt"; then printf '<testsuite><testcase name="ALP-001"><failure/></testcase></testsuite>' > "$3"; exit 1; fi
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "failing_eval"},
		{"missing id with unrelated failure", `#!/bin/sh
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
if test -f "$2/evals/missing.txt"; then printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"><failure/></testcase></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"; exit 1; fi
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "missing_id"},
		{"missing id without report", `#!/bin/sh
if test -f "$2/evals/missing.txt"; then echo 'hook failed' >&2; exit 2; fi
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "missing_id"},
	} {

}

func Test_CHK_055_BaselineAndRecoveryFailures(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, path, script, phase, hook string }{
		{"baseline eval failure", ".fireweed/eval.sh", "#!/bin/sh\necho baseline-eval-failed >&2\nexit 9\n", "baseline", "eval"},
		{"baseline boundary failure", ".fireweed/boundary.sh", "#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'alpha: baseline violation\\n'\n", "baseline", "boundar"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			f.put(tc.path, tc.script)
			logDoctorCanaryProbes(t, f)
			f.commit()
			r := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(r, "C14", false, tc.phase, tc.hook) {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline accepted: %s", doctorText(r))
			}
			if !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "probe:") {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline hook did not run: %s", doctorLog(f))
			}
			if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "planted:") {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline continued into canary probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
			}
		})
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, failure string }{
		{"recovery eval failure", "echo recovery-eval-failed >&2; exit 9"},
		{"recovery coverage failure", "printf '<testsuite/>' > \"$3\"; exit 0"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			original := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, ".fireweed/eval.sh")))
			injection := "if test -f \"$2/evals/failing.txt\"; then printf '%s' \"$2\" > .fireweed/eval-recovery-module; fi\n" +
				"if test -f .fireweed/eval-recovery-module && test \"$(cat .fireweed/eval-recovery-module)\" = \"$2\" && ! test -f \"$2/evals/failing.txt\"; then " + tc.failure + "; fi\n"
			f.put(".fireweed/eval.sh", strings.Replace(original, "#!/bin/sh\n", "#!/bin/sh\n"+injection, 1))
			f.commit()
			r := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(r, "C14", false, "recovery", "failing_eval", "eval") {
				t.Errorf("failed %s accepted: %s", tc.name, doctorText(r))
			}
		})
	}
}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "fmt"

+ "os/exec"

+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func object(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func stringValue(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsValue(v any) []string { switch x:=v.(type) {case []string: return x; case []any: out:=[]string{}; for _,e:=range x { if s,ok:=e.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)} }; return out }; return nil }
+func hook(config map[string]any, key string) any { return object(config["hooks"])[key] }
+func moduleHook(fm map[string]any,key string) any { return object(fm["hooks"])[key] }
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\\''")+"'" }
+
+type command struct { shell string; argv []string; isShell bool }
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {
+ switch x:=v.(type) {
+ case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")}; return command{shell:x,isShell:true},nil
+ case []string: if len(x)==0 || x[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; return command{argv:append([]string(nil),x...)},nil
+ case []any: if len(x)==0 {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; a:=make([]string,len(x));for i,e:=range x {s,ok:=e.(string); if !ok {return command{},fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")};a[i]=s};if a[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:a},nil
+ default: return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")
+ }
+}
+func expand(s string, values map[string]string, quote bool) string {
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} {if v,ok:=values[k];ok {if quote {v=shellQuote(v)}; pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)}}
+ return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+func (c command) expanded(values map[string]string) command {
+ if c.isShell {c.shell=expand(c.shell,values,true)} else {for i:=range c.argv {c.argv[i]=expand(c.argv[i],values,false)}};return c
+}
+func (c command) uses(key string) bool { p:="{"+key+"}";if c.isShell {return strings.Contains(c.shell,p)};for _,s:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(s,p){return true}};return false }
+func (c command) display() string {if c.isShell{return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type processResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) processResult {
+ if timeout>0 {var cancel context.CancelFunc;ctx,cancel=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()}
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.isShell {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,"sh","-c",c.shell)} else {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,c.argv[0],c.argv[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir; cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err==nil {stop:=context.AfterFunc(ctx,func(){if cmd.Process!=nil { _=syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL) }});err=cmd.Wait();stop()}
+ r:=processResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}
+ if cmd.ProcessState!=nil {r.exit=cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode()}
+ if ctx.Err()!=nil {r.err=ctx.Err()}
+ return r
+}
+func inside(root,path string) string {if filepath.IsAbs(path){return path};return filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path))}

+func gitPaths(root,rev string)([]string,error){s,e:=gitOutput(root,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",rev);if e!=nil{return nil,e};if s==""{return nil,nil};return strings.Split(s,"\n"),nil}

+type fileDelta struct{status,path,old string}
+func deltas(root,parent,child string,merge bool)([]fileDelta,error){var args []string;if merge {args=[]string{"diff-tree","--cc","--name-only","-r",child}} else {args=[]string{"diff","--name-status","-M",parent,child}};raw,e:=gitOutput(root,args...);if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]fileDelta{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(raw,"\n") {if line==""{continue};if merge {if len(line)==40&&line==child{continue};out=append(out,fileDelta{status:"M",path:line});continue};f:=strings.Split(line,"\t");if len(f)<2{continue};d:=fileDelta{status:f[0],path:f[1]};if strings.HasPrefix(d.status,"R")&&len(f)>=3 {d.old=f[1];d.path=f[2]};out=append(out,d)};return out,nil}
+func findModule(s project.Snapshot,path string)*project.Module{for i:=range s.Modules{if pathUnder(path,s.Modules[i].Dir){return &s.Modules[i]}};return nil}
+func zoneIn(s project.Snapshot,path string,kind string)bool{m:=findModule(s,path);if m==nil{return false};rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,m.Dir+"/");return contracts.ResolveZone(rel,m.Zones)==kind}
+func History(root,revisionRange string)(model.HistoryReport,error){
+ result:=model.HistoryReport{Commits:[]string{}};if revisionRange=="" {snap,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return result,e};base:=stringValue(snap.Config["base"]);if base==""{return result,fmt.Errorf("missing configured base")};resolved,e:=gitOutput(root,"rev-parse","--verify",base);if e!=nil{return result,e};merge,e:=gitOutput(root,"merge-base","HEAD",resolved);if e!=nil{return result,e};revisionRange=merge+"..HEAD"}
+ raw,e:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--topo-order","--reverse",revisionRange);if e!=nil{return result,e};if raw==""{return result,nil};result.Commits=strings.Split(raw,"\n")
+ for _,oid:=range result.Commits {parentLine,e:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--parents","-n","1",oid);if e!=nil{return result,e};fields:=strings.Fields(parentLine);parents:=fields[1:];before:="";if len(parents)>0 {before=parents[0]}
+  afterSnap,e:=project.LoadAt(root,oid);if e!=nil{return result,e};var beforeSnap project.Snapshot;if before!=""{beforeSnap,e=project.LoadAt(root,before);if e!=nil{return result,e}}
+  beforeChanges,e:=changeStates(root,before);if e!=nil{return result,e};afterChanges,e:=changeStates(root,oid);if e!=nil{return result,e}
+  parentStates:=[]map[string]struct{path,phase,module string}{};for _,p:=range parents {states,e:=changeStates(root,p);if e!=nil{return result,e};parentStates=append(parentStates,states)}
+  worker:=false;applied:=false;squashed:=false;workerModule:="";projected:=afterSnap
+  for name,state:=range afterChanges {newPhase:=true;hadImpl:=false;for _,p:=range parentStates {if previous,ok:=p[name];ok {if previous.phase==state.phase{newPhase=false};if previous.phase=="impl"{hadImpl=true}}};if !newPhase{continue};if state.phase=="audit"||state.phase=="evals"||state.phase=="impl"||state.phase=="applied"{worker=true;workerModule=state.module};if state.phase=="applied" {applied=true;if !hadImpl {squashed=true;result.Squashed=append(result.Squashed,model.SquashedChange{Commit:oid,Change:state.path})}}}
+  _=beforeChanges

+  seen:=map[string]bool{};add:=func(code,path string){key:=code+"|"+path;if seen[key]{return};seen[key]=true;result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s in commit %s",code,oid)})}

+    if (zoneIn(beforeSnap,path,"append_only")||zoneIn(afterSnap,path,"append_only"))&&(d.status!="A") {add("H03",path)}
+    if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/archive/")&&d.status!="A"&&d.status!="D"&&path==d.path{add("H04",path)}
+   }}
+ }
+ return result,nil
+}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"

+ "os"

+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module)([]contracts.Item,error){body,ok:=contracts.Section(m.Document.Body,"Specs");if !ok{return nil,nil};items,err:=contracts.ParseItems(body);if err!=nil {msg:=err.Error();if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(msg),"duplicate") {return nil,coded("C05","%s",msg)};return nil,coded("C03","%s",msg)};return items,nil}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, req model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+ var m *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module {m=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}};if m==nil{return model.Report{},coded("U02","unknown module %q",req.Module)}
+ specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*m);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+ h:=moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter,"eval");if h==nil {h=hook(req.Snapshot.Config,"eval")};if h==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",m.Name)}
+ c,err:=parseCommand(h);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","%v",err)}
+ f,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};reportPath:=f.Name();f.Close();os.Remove(reportPath);defer os.Remove(reportPath)
+ values:=map[string]string{"module":m.Name,"module_dir":m.Dir,"report":reportPath};c=c.expanded(values)
+ r:=runCommand(ctx,c,req.Snapshot.Root,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":req.Bin},req.Timeout)
+ report:=model.Report{HookExit:r.exit,Stdout:r.stdout,Stderr:r.stderr}
+ if r.err!=nil {var exit *os.PathError;var ex interface{ ExitCode() int };if errors.As(r.err,&exit)||!errors.As(r.err,&ex){return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",r.err)}}
+ data,err:=os.ReadFile(reportPath);if err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","read JUnit report: %v",err)}
+ parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+ failed:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"{failed=true;break}}
+ if (r.exit==0)==failed {return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",r.exit)}
+ return report,nil
+}
+
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context,req model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+ snap:=req.Snapshot;diags:=[]project.Diagnostic{};var causes []error
+ baseline:=map[string]bool{};if data,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root,".fireweed","boundaries-baseline"));e==nil {for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(data),"\n") {if line!="" {baseline[line]=true}}}
+ global:=hook(snap.Config,"boundaries")
+ run:=func(label string,h any){c,e:=parseCommand(h);if e!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:label+": "+e.Error()});causes=append(causes,e);return};r:=runCommand(ctx,c.expanded(map[string]string{}),snap.Root,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":req.Bin},req.Timeout);if r.err!=nil {var ex interface{ExitCode()int};if !errors.As(r.err,&ex)||ctx.Err()!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:label+": "+r.err.Error()});causes=append(causes,r.err);return}}
+  for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr,"\n"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line==""||baseline[line] {continue};suppressed:=false;for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);if reason!=""&&strings.HasPrefix(line,m.Name+":") {suppressed=true;break}};if suppressed{continue};diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X01",Message:line});causes=append(causes,fmt.Errorf("%s",line))}
+ }
+ if global!=nil {run("global boundaries hook",global)}
+ for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);if reason!="" {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X03",Message:m.Name+": boundaries opt out: "+reason,Warning:true})}
+  override:=moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter,"boundaries");if override!=nil {run(m.Name+" boundaries hook",override)} else if global==nil {if len(m.Zones.Disposable)>0&&reason=="" {msg:=m.Name+": missing boundaries hook";diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:msg});causes=append(causes,errors.New(msg))} else {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X04",Message:m.Name+": no boundary enforcement required",Warning:true})}}
+ }
+ return diags,errors.Join(causes...)
+}

+func ParseJUnit(data []byte,specs []contracts.Item)(model.Report,error){
+ dec:=xml.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)));root,err:=dec.Token();if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+ start,ok:=root.(xml.StartElement);if !ok || (start.Name.Local!="testsuite"&&start.Name.Local!="testsuites") {name:="";if ok{name=start.Name.Local};return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",name)}
+ report:=model.Report{Cases:[]model.Case{}};depth:=1

+  switch v:=tok.(type){case xml.StartElement:depth++;if v.Name.Local!="testcase" {continue};var raw junitCase;if e:=dec.DecodeElement(&raw,&v);e!=nil{return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",e)};depth--

+   for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname){c.IDs=append(c.IDs,s.ID)}}
+   if len(c.IDs)==0 {for _,candidate:=range []string{c.Name,c.Classname} {for _,m:=range specToken.FindAllStringSubmatch(candidate,-1) {id:=strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(m[2],"_","-"));for _,s:=range specs {prefix:=strings.SplitN(strings.ToUpper(s.ID),"-",2)[0];if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ReplaceAll(id,"-",""),prefix) {return report,coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,m[2])}}}};return report,coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)}

+  case xml.EndElement:depth--}
+ }
+ if _,e:=dec.Token();e!=io.EOF {if e!=nil{return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",e)};return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: trailing XML")}

+func hasID(ids []string,id string)bool{for _,x:=range ids{if x==id{return true}};return false}
+func exemptTag(tag string)bool {s:=strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag));return strings.HasPrefix(s,"review")||strings.HasPrefix(s,"quarantine")}
+func RequireCoverage(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error{for _,s:=range specs {if exemptTag(s.Tag){continue};found:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases {if c.Result!="skip"&&hasID(c.IDs,s.ID){found=true;break}};if !found{return coded("C10","no coverage for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func RequireFailFirst(report model.Report,ids,already []string)error{for _,id:=range ids {if hasID(already,id){continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"&&hasID(c.IDs,id){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("P2-01","no fail-first case for %s",id)}};return nil}
+func RequirePass(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error{for _,c:=range report.Cases {if c.Result!="fail" {continue};for _,id:=range c.IDs {for _,s:=range specs {if s.ID==id&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(s.Tag),"quarantine") {return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s",c.Name,id)}}}};return nil}
+var _=fmt.Sprintf

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4c29719381b13663aee4e77a5fee9ee4baf17662
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func pathUnder(path,dir string) bool {path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));dir=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(dir)),"/");return strings.HasPrefix(path,dir+"/")}
+func matchAny(globs []string,path string) bool {for _,g:=range globs {if contracts.MatchGlob(g,path){return true}};return false}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev==""{return false};_,err:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,rev,path);return err==nil}
+func Zones(req model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {
+ var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module {target=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+ bad:=[]project.Diagnostic{};reject:=func(path,reason string){bad=append(bad,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:reason})}
+ check:=func(path string,src bool) {if path=="" {return};path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));if path==req.ChangePath {return}
+  if pathUnder(path,"changes") {reject(path,"other change file");return}
+  if pathUnder(path,".fireweed")||matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path) {reject(path,"protected path");return}
+  for _,m:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if path==m.Dir+"/SPEC.md" {reject(path,"module SPEC.md");return};if pathUnder(path,m.Dir)&&m.Name!=req.Module {reject(path,"another module");return}}
+  if req.Phase=="audit" {reject(path,"audit permits only current change");return}
+  if target!=nil&&pathUnder(path,target.Dir) {rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(target.Dir,"/")+"/");zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones);switch zone {
+   case "protected":reject(path,"protected zone")
+   case "evals":if req.Phase!="evals" {reject(path,"evals zone")}
+   case "interface":if req.Phase!="evals"||!req.InterfaceDeclared {reject(path,"interface zone")}
+   case "append_only":if req.Phase!="impl"||src||existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path) {reject(path,"append_only zone")}
+   case "disposable":if req.Phase=="evals"&&(src||existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path)){reject(path,"existing disposable file")}
+   case "preserve":if req.Phase=="evals" {reject(path,"preserve zone")}
+   }
+   return
+  }
+  if !matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),path){reject(path,"outside worker_writable")}
+ }
+ for _,c:=range req.Changes {if c.OldPath!="" {check(c.OldPath,true)};check(c.Path,false)}
+ return bad
+}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func object(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func stringValue(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsValue(v any) []string { switch x:=v.(type) {case []string: return x; case []any: out:=[]string{}; for _,e:=range x { if s,ok:=e.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)} }; return out }; return nil }
+func hook(config map[string]any, key string) any { return object(config["hooks"])[key] }
+func moduleHook(fm map[string]any,key string) any { return object(fm["hooks"])[key] }
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\\''")+"'" }
+
+type command struct { shell string; argv []string; isShell bool }
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {
+ switch x:=v.(type) {
+ case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")}; return command{shell:x,isShell:true},nil
+ case []string: if len(x)==0 || x[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; return command{argv:append([]string(nil),x...)},nil
+ case []any: if len(x)==0 {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; a:=make([]string,len(x));for i,e:=range x {s,ok:=e.(string); if !ok {return command{},fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")};a[i]=s};if a[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:a},nil
+ default: return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")
+ }
+}
+func expand(s string, values map[string]string, quote bool) string {
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} {if v,ok:=values[k];ok {if quote {v=shellQuote(v)}; pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)}}
+ return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+func (c command) expanded(values map[string]string) command {
+ if c.isShell {c.shell=expand(c.shell,values,true)} else {for i:=range c.argv {c.argv[i]=expand(c.argv[i],values,false)}};return c
+}
+func (c command) uses(key string) bool { p:="{"+key+"}";if c.isShell {return strings.Contains(c.shell,p)};for _,s:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(s,p){return true}};return false }
+func (c command) display() string {if c.isShell{return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type processResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) processResult {
+ if timeout>0 {var cancel context.CancelFunc;ctx,cancel=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()}
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.isShell {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,"sh","-c",c.shell)} else {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,c.argv[0],c.argv[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir; cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err==nil {stop:=context.AfterFunc(ctx,func(){if cmd.Process!=nil { _=syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL) }});err=cmd.Wait();stop()}
+ r:=processResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}
+ if cmd.ProcessState!=nil {r.exit=cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode()}
+ if ctx.Err()!=nil {r.err=ctx.Err()}
+ return r
+}
+func inside(root,path string) string {if filepath.IsAbs(path){return path};return filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path))}

+func doctorEval(ctx context.Context,snap project.Snapshot,m project.Module,h any,req model.DoctorRequest)error{fm:=m.Document.Frontmatter;if fm==nil{fm=map[string]any{}};copyFM:=map[string]any{};for k,v:=range fm{copyFM[k]=v};copyFM["hooks"]=map[string]any{"eval":h};m.Document.Frontmatter=copyFM;snap.Modules=[]project.Module{m};rep,e:=Evaluate(ctx,model.HookRequest{Snapshot:snap,Module:m.Name,Bin:req.Bin,Timeout:req.Timeout});if e!=nil{return e};specs,e:=moduleSpecs(m);if e!=nil{return e};if e=RequireCoverage(rep,specs);e!=nil{return e};return RequirePass(rep,specs)}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "fmt"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func gitOutput(root string,args ...string)(string,error){c:=exec.Command("git",append([]string{"-C",root},args...)...);b,e:=c.CombinedOutput();if e!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),e,b)};return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),nil}
+func gitPaths(root,rev string)([]string,error){s,e:=gitOutput(root,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",rev);if e!=nil{return nil,e};if s==""{return nil,nil};return strings.Split(s,"\n"),nil}
+func changeStates(root,rev string)(map[string]struct{path,phase,module string},error){out:=map[string]struct{path,phase,module string}{};if rev=="" {return out,nil};paths,e:=gitPaths(root,rev);if e!=nil{return nil,e};for _,p:=range paths {if !strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/")||!strings.HasSuffix(p,".md"){continue};raw,e:=gitOutput(root,"show",rev+":"+p);if e!=nil{return nil,e};doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return nil,e};out[filepath.Base(p)]=struct{path,phase,module string}{p,stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]),stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["module"])}};return out,nil}
+type fileDelta struct{status,path,old string}
+func deltas(root,parent,child string,merge bool)([]fileDelta,error){var args []string;if merge {args=[]string{"diff-tree","--cc","--name-only","-r",child}} else {args=[]string{"diff","--name-status","-M",parent,child}};raw,e:=gitOutput(root,args...);if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]fileDelta{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(raw,"\n") {if line==""{continue};if merge {if len(line)==40&&line==child{continue};out=append(out,fileDelta{status:"M",path:line});continue};f:=strings.Split(line,"\t");if len(f)<2{continue};d:=fileDelta{status:f[0],path:f[1]};if strings.HasPrefix(d.status,"R")&&len(f)>=3 {d.old=f[1];d.path=f[2]};out=append(out,d)};return out,nil}
+func findModule(s project.Snapshot,path string)*project.Module{for i:=range s.Modules{if pathUnder(path,s.Modules[i].Dir){return &s.Modules[i]}};return nil}
+func zoneIn(s project.Snapshot,path string,kind string)bool{m:=findModule(s,path);if m==nil{return false};rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,m.Dir+"/");return contracts.ResolveZone(rel,m.Zones)==kind}
+func History(root,revisionRange string)(model.HistoryReport,error){
+ result:=model.HistoryReport{Commits:[]string{}};if revisionRange=="" {snap,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return result,e};base:=stringValue(snap.Config["base"]);if base==""{return result,fmt.Errorf("missing configured base")};resolved,e:=gitOutput(root,"rev-parse","--verify",base);if e!=nil{return result,e};merge,e:=gitOutput(root,"merge-base","HEAD",resolved);if e!=nil{return result,e};revisionRange=merge+"..HEAD"}
+ raw,e:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--topo-order","--reverse",revisionRange);if e!=nil{return result,e};if raw==""{return result,nil};result.Commits=strings.Split(raw,"\n")
+ for _,oid:=range result.Commits {parentLine,e:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--parents","-n","1",oid);if e!=nil{return result,e};fields:=strings.Fields(parentLine);parents:=fields[1:];before:="";if len(parents)>0 {before=parents[0]}
+  afterSnap,e:=project.LoadAt(root,oid);if e!=nil{return result,e};var beforeSnap project.Snapshot;if before!=""{beforeSnap,e=project.LoadAt(root,before);if e!=nil{return result,e}}
+  beforeChanges,e:=changeStates(root,before);if e!=nil{return result,e};afterChanges,e:=changeStates(root,oid);if e!=nil{return result,e}
+  parentStates:=[]map[string]struct{path,phase,module string}{};for _,p:=range parents {states,e:=changeStates(root,p);if e!=nil{return result,e};parentStates=append(parentStates,states)}
+  worker:=false;applied:=false;squashed:=false;workerModule:="";projected:=afterSnap
+  for name,state:=range afterChanges {newPhase:=true;hadImpl:=false;for _,p:=range parentStates {if previous,ok:=p[name];ok {if previous.phase==state.phase{newPhase=false};if previous.phase=="impl"{hadImpl=true}}};if !newPhase{continue};if state.phase=="audit"||state.phase=="evals"||state.phase=="impl"||state.phase=="applied"{worker=true;workerModule=state.module};if state.phase=="applied" {applied=true;if !hadImpl {squashed=true;result.Squashed=append(result.Squashed,model.SquashedChange{Commit:oid,Change:state.path})}}}
+  _=beforeChanges
+  ds,e:=deltas(root,before,oid,len(parents)>1);if e!=nil{return result,e};if len(parents)>1 {for _,p:=range parents {extra,e:=deltas(root,p,oid,false);if e!=nil{return result,e};for _,d:=range extra {if zoneIn(beforeSnap,d.path,"append_only")||zoneIn(afterSnap,d.path,"append_only"){ds=append(ds,d)}}}}
+  seen:=map[string]bool{};add:=func(code,path string){key:=code+"|"+path;if seen[key]{return};seen[key]=true;result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s in commit %s",code,oid)})}
+  for _,d:=range ds {paths:=[]string{d.path};if d.old!="" {paths=append(paths,d.old)};for _,path:=range paths {if path==""{continue};if worker&&!squashed {if strings.HasPrefix(path,".fireweed/playbooks/")||matchAny(stringsValue(beforeSnap.Config["protected"]),path)||matchAny(stringsValue(afterSnap.Config["protected"]),path){add("H01",path)};if applied {m:=findModule(projected,path);if m!=nil&&m.Name==workerModule&&(zoneIn(beforeSnap,path,"evals")||zoneIn(beforeSnap,path,"interface")||zoneIn(projected,path,"evals")||zoneIn(projected,path,"interface")){add("H02",path)}}}
+    if (zoneIn(beforeSnap,path,"append_only")||zoneIn(afterSnap,path,"append_only"))&&(d.status!="A") {add("H03",path)}
+    if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/archive/")&&d.status!="A"&&d.status!="D"&&path==d.path{add("H04",path)}
+   }}
+ }
+ return result,nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/hooks.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/hooks.go

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module)([]contracts.Item,error){body,ok:=contracts.Section(m.Document.Body,"Specs");if !ok{return nil,nil};items,err:=contracts.ParseItems(body);if err!=nil {msg:=err.Error();if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(msg),"duplicate") {return nil,coded("C05","%s",msg)};return nil,coded("C03","%s",msg)};return items,nil}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, req model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+ var m *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module {m=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}};if m==nil{return model.Report{},coded("U02","unknown module %q",req.Module)}
+ specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*m);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+ h:=moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter,"eval");if h==nil {h=hook(req.Snapshot.Config,"eval")};if h==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",m.Name)}
+ c,err:=parseCommand(h);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","%v",err)}
+ f,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};reportPath:=f.Name();f.Close();os.Remove(reportPath);defer os.Remove(reportPath)
+ values:=map[string]string{"module":m.Name,"module_dir":m.Dir,"report":reportPath};c=c.expanded(values)
+ r:=runCommand(ctx,c,req.Snapshot.Root,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":req.Bin},req.Timeout)
+ report:=model.Report{HookExit:r.exit,Stdout:r.stdout,Stderr:r.stderr}
+ if r.err!=nil {var exit *os.PathError;var ex interface{ ExitCode() int };if errors.As(r.err,&exit)||!errors.As(r.err,&ex){return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",r.err)}}
+ data,err:=os.ReadFile(reportPath);if err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","read JUnit report: %v",err)}
+ parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+ failed:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"{failed=true;break}}
+ if (r.exit==0)==failed {return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",r.exit)}
+ return report,nil
+}
+
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context,req model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+ snap:=req.Snapshot;diags:=[]project.Diagnostic{};var causes []error
+ baseline:=map[string]bool{};if data,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root,".fireweed","boundaries-baseline"));e==nil {for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(data),"\n") {if line!="" {baseline[line]=true}}}
+ global:=hook(snap.Config,"boundaries")
+ run:=func(label string,h any){c,e:=parseCommand(h);if e!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:label+": "+e.Error()});causes=append(causes,e);return};r:=runCommand(ctx,c.expanded(map[string]string{}),snap.Root,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":req.Bin},req.Timeout);if r.err!=nil {var ex interface{ExitCode()int};if !errors.As(r.err,&ex)||ctx.Err()!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:label+": "+r.err.Error()});causes=append(causes,r.err);return}}
+  for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr,"\n"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line==""||baseline[line] {continue};suppressed:=false;for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);if reason!=""&&strings.HasPrefix(line,m.Name+":") {suppressed=true;break}};if suppressed{continue};diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X01",Message:line});causes=append(causes,fmt.Errorf("%s",line))}
+ }
+ if global!=nil {run("global boundaries hook",global)}
+ for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);if reason!="" {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X03",Message:m.Name+": boundaries opt out: "+reason,Warning:true})}
+  override:=moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter,"boundaries");if override!=nil {run(m.Name+" boundaries hook",override)} else if global==nil {if len(m.Zones.Disposable)>0&&reason=="" {msg:=m.Name+": missing boundaries hook";diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:msg});causes=append(causes,errors.New(msg))} else {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X04",Message:m.Name+": no boundary enforcement required",Warning:true})}}
+ }
+ return diags,errors.Join(causes...)
+}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..5d0bbd61c928ced89fca1a930037ac21ab9fecc6

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "encoding/xml"
+ "fmt"
+ "io"
+ "regexp"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitCase struct { Name string `xml:"name,attr"`; Classname string `xml:"classname,attr"`; Time string `xml:"time,attr"`; Failure []junitProblem `xml:"failure"`; Error []junitProblem `xml:"error"`; Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"` }
+type junitProblem struct { Message string `xml:"message,attr"`; Body string `xml:",chardata"` }
+var specToken=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(^|[^a-z0-9])([a-z]+[-_]?[0-9]{3,})([^0-9]|$)`)
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte,specs []contracts.Item)(model.Report,error){
+ dec:=xml.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)));root,err:=dec.Token();if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+ start,ok:=root.(xml.StartElement);if !ok || (start.Name.Local!="testsuite"&&start.Name.Local!="testsuites") {name:="";if ok{name=start.Name.Local};return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",name)}
+ report:=model.Report{Cases:[]model.Case{}};depth:=1
+ for depth>0 {tok,e:=dec.Token();if e!=nil {if e==io.EOF {return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: unexpected EOF")};return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",e)}
+  switch v:=tok.(type){case xml.StartElement:depth++;if v.Name.Local!="testcase" {continue};var raw junitCase;if e:=dec.DecodeElement(&raw,&v);e!=nil{return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",e)};depth--
+   c:=model.Case{Name:raw.Name,Classname:raw.Classname,Result:"pass"};if raw.Time!="" {c.Seconds,_=strconv.ParseFloat(raw.Time,64)}
+   if len(raw.Skipped)>0 {c.Result="skip"};if len(raw.Failure)>0||len(raw.Error)>0 {c.Result="fail";parts:=[]string{};for _,p:=range append(raw.Failure,raw.Error...) {if s:=strings.TrimSpace(p.Message);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)};if s:=strings.TrimSpace(p.Body);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)}};c.Failure=strings.Join(parts,"\n")}
+   for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname){c.IDs=append(c.IDs,s.ID)}}
+   if len(c.IDs)==0 {for _,candidate:=range []string{c.Name,c.Classname} {for _,m:=range specToken.FindAllStringSubmatch(candidate,-1) {id:=strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(m[2],"_","-"));for _,s:=range specs {prefix:=strings.SplitN(strings.ToUpper(s.ID),"-",2)[0];if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ReplaceAll(id,"-",""),prefix) {return report,coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,m[2])}}}};return report,coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)}
+   report.Seconds+=c.Seconds;report.Cases=append(report.Cases,c)
+  case xml.EndElement:depth--}
+ }
+ if _,e:=dec.Token();e!=io.EOF {if e!=nil{return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",e)};return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: trailing XML")}
+ return report,nil
+}
+func hasID(ids []string,id string)bool{for _,x:=range ids{if x==id{return true}};return false}
+func exemptTag(tag string)bool {s:=strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag));return strings.HasPrefix(s,"review")||strings.HasPrefix(s,"quarantine")}
+func RequireCoverage(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error{for _,s:=range specs {if exemptTag(s.Tag){continue};found:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases {if c.Result!="skip"&&hasID(c.IDs,s.ID){found=true;break}};if !found{return coded("C10","no coverage for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func RequireFailFirst(report model.Report,ids,already []string)error{for _,id:=range ids {if hasID(already,id){continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"&&hasID(c.IDs,id){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("P2-01","no fail-first case for %s",id)}};return nil}
+func RequirePass(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error{for _,c:=range report.Cases {if c.Result!="fail" {continue};for _,id:=range c.IDs {for _,s:=range specs {if s.ID==id&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(s.Tag),"quarantine") {return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s",c.Name,id)}}}};return nil}
+var _=fmt.Sprintf
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4c29719381b13663aee4e77a5fee9ee4baf17662
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func pathUnder(path,dir string) bool {path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));dir=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(dir)),"/");return strings.HasPrefix(path,dir+"/")}
+func matchAny(globs []string,path string) bool {for _,g:=range globs {if contracts.MatchGlob(g,path){return true}};return false}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev==""{return false};_,err:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,rev,path);return err==nil}
+func Zones(req model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {
+ var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module {target=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+ bad:=[]project.Diagnostic{};reject:=func(path,reason string){bad=append(bad,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:reason})}
+ check:=func(path string,src bool) {if path=="" {return};path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));if path==req.ChangePath {return}
+  if pathUnder(path,"changes") {reject(path,"other change file");return}
+  if pathUnder(path,".fireweed")||matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path) {reject(path,"protected path");return}
+  for _,m:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if path==m.Dir+"/SPEC.md" {reject(path,"module SPEC.md");return};if pathUnder(path,m.Dir)&&m.Name!=req.Module {reject(path,"another module");return}}
+  if req.Phase=="audit" {reject(path,"audit permits only current change");return}
+  if target!=nil&&pathUnder(path,target.Dir) {rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(target.Dir,"/")+"/");zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones);switch zone {
+   case "protected":reject(path,"protected zone")
+   case "evals":if req.Phase!="evals" {reject(path,"evals zone")}
+   case "interface":if req.Phase!="evals"||!req.InterfaceDeclared {reject(path,"interface zone")}
+   case "append_only":if req.Phase!="impl"||src||existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path) {reject(path,"append_only zone")}
+   case "disposable":if req.Phase=="evals"&&(src||existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path)){reject(path,"existing disposable file")}
+   case "preserve":if req.Phase=="evals" {reject(path,"preserve zone")}
+   }
+   return
+  }
+  if !matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),path){reject(path,"outside worker_writable")}
+ }
+ for _,c:=range req.Changes {if c.OldPath!="" {check(c.OldPath,true)};check(c.Path,false)}
+ return bad
+}

diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b5a3bac4b4399805f074355a3e9ebf4ecae0caa5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func object(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func stringValue(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsValue(v any) []string { switch x:=v.(type) {case []string: return x; case []any: out:=[]string{}; for _,e:=range x { if s,ok:=e.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)} }; return out }; return nil }
+func hook(config map[string]any, key string) any { return object(config["hooks"])[key] }
+func moduleHook(fm map[string]any,key string) any { return object(fm["hooks"])[key] }
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\\''")+"'" }
+
+type command struct { shell string; argv []string; isShell bool }
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {
+ switch x:=v.(type) {
+ case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")}; return command{shell:x,isShell:true},nil
+ case []string: if len(x)==0 || x[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; return command{argv:append([]string(nil),x...)},nil
+ case []any: if len(x)==0 {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; a:=make([]string,len(x));for i,e:=range x {s,ok:=e.(string); if !ok {return command{},fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")};a[i]=s};if a[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:a},nil
+ default: return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")
+ }
+}
+func expand(s string, values map[string]string, quote bool) string {
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} {if v,ok:=values[k];ok {if quote {v=shellQuote(v)}; pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)}}
+ return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+func (c command) expanded(values map[string]string) command {
+ if c.isShell {c.shell=expand(c.shell,values,true)} else {for i:=range c.argv {c.argv[i]=expand(c.argv[i],values,false)}};return c
+}
+func (c command) uses(key string) bool { p:="{"+key+"}";if c.isShell {return strings.Contains(c.shell,p)};for _,s:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(s,p){return true}};return false }
+func (c command) display() string {if c.isShell{return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type processResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) processResult {
+ if timeout>0 {var cancel context.CancelFunc;ctx,cancel=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()}
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.isShell {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,"sh","-c",c.shell)} else {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,c.argv[0],c.argv[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir; cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err==nil {stop:=context.AfterFunc(ctx,func(){if cmd.Process!=nil { _=syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL) }});err=cmd.Wait();stop()}
+ r:=processResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}
+ if cmd.ProcessState!=nil {r.exit=cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode()}
+ if ctx.Err()!=nil {r.err=ctx.Err()}
+ return r
+}

+  parentStates:=[]map[string]struct{path,phase,module string}{};for _,p:=range parents {states,e:=changeStates(root,p);if e!=nil{return result,e};parentStates=append(parentStates,states)}
+  worker:=false;applied:=false;squashed:=false;workerModule:="";projected:=afterSnap
+  for name,state:=range afterChanges {newPhase:=true;hadImpl:=false;for _,p:=range parentStates {if previous,ok:=p[name];ok {if previous.phase==state.phase{newPhase=false};if previous.phase=="impl"{hadImpl=true}}};if !newPhase{continue};if state.phase=="audit"||state.phase=="evals"||state.phase=="impl"||state.phase=="applied"{worker=true;workerModule=state.module};if state.phase=="applied" {applied=true;if !hadImpl {squashed=true;result.Squashed=append(result.Squashed,model.SquashedChange{Commit:oid,Change:state.path})}}}
+  _=beforeChanges
+  ds,e:=deltas(root,before,oid,len(parents)>1);if e!=nil{return result,e};if len(parents)>1 {for _,p:=range parents {extra,e:=deltas(root,p,oid,false);if e!=nil{return result,e};for _,d:=range extra {if zoneIn(beforeSnap,d.path,"append_only")||zoneIn(afterSnap,d.path,"append_only"){ds=append(ds,d)}}}}
+  seen:=map[string]bool{};add:=func(code,path string){key:=code+"|"+path;if seen[key]{return};seen[key]=true;result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s in commit %s",code,oid)})}
+  for _,d:=range ds {paths:=[]string{d.path};if d.old!="" {paths=append(paths,d.old)};for _,path:=range paths {if path==""{continue};if worker&&!squashed {if strings.HasPrefix(path,".fireweed/playbooks/")||matchAny(stringsValue(beforeSnap.Config["protected"]),path)||matchAny(stringsValue(afterSnap.Config["protected"]),path){add("H01",path)};if applied {m:=findModule(projected,path);if m!=nil&&m.Name==workerModule&&(zoneIn(beforeSnap,path,"evals")||zoneIn(beforeSnap,path,"interface")||zoneIn(projected,path,"evals")||zoneIn(projected,path,"interface")){add("H02",path)}}}
+    if (zoneIn(beforeSnap,path,"append_only")||zoneIn(afterSnap,path,"append_only"))&&(d.status!="A") {add("H03",path)}
+    if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/archive/")&&d.status!="A"&&d.status!="D"&&path==d.path{add("H04",path)}
