index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b5a3bac4b4399805f074355a3e9ebf4ecae0caa5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func object(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func stringValue(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsValue(v any) []string { switch x:=v.(type) {case []string: return x; case []any: out:=[]string{}; for _,e:=range x { if s,ok:=e.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)} }; return out }; return nil }
+func hook(config map[string]any, key string) any { return object(config["hooks"])[key] }
+func moduleHook(fm map[string]any,key string) any { return object(fm["hooks"])[key] }
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\\''")+"'" }
+
+type command struct { shell string; argv []string; isShell bool }
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {
+ switch x:=v.(type) {
+ case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")}; return command{shell:x,isShell:true},nil
+ case []string: if len(x)==0 || x[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; return command{argv:append([]string(nil),x...)},nil
+ case []any: if len(x)==0 {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; a:=make([]string,len(x));for i,e:=range x {s,ok:=e.(string); if !ok {return command{},fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")};a[i]=s};if a[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:a},nil
+ default: return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")
+ }
+}
+func expand(s string, values map[string]string, quote bool) string {
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} {if v,ok:=values[k];ok {if quote {v=shellQuote(v)}; pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)}}
+ return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+func (c command) expanded(values map[string]string) command {
+ if c.isShell {c.shell=expand(c.shell,values,true)} else {for i:=range c.argv {c.argv[i]=expand(c.argv[i],values,false)}};return c
+}
+func (c command) uses(key string) bool { p:="{"+key+"}";if c.isShell {return strings.Contains(c.shell,p)};for _,s:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(s,p){return true}};return false }
+func (c command) display() string {if c.isShell{return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type processResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) processResult {
+ if timeout>0 {var cancel context.CancelFunc;ctx,cancel=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()}
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.isShell {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,"sh","-c",c.shell)} else {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,c.argv[0],c.argv[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir; cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err==nil {stop:=context.AfterFunc(ctx,func(){if cmd.Process!=nil { _=syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL) }});err=cmd.Wait();stop()}
+ r:=processResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}
+ if cmd.ProcessState!=nil {r.exit=cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode()}
+ if ctx.Err()!=nil {r.err=ctx.Err()}
+ return r
+}
+func inside(root,path string) string {if filepath.IsAbs(path){return path};return filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path))}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..08d9f6cf4279eaa33466298d9d7a424f9aed8458
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor.go
@@ -0,0 +1,470 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+)
+
+const doctorPrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
+const doctorGuidance = "<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->\n"
+
+type canaryMap struct {
+	Version      int               `yaml:"version"`
+	Baseline     map[string]string `yaml:"baseline"`
+	Undeclared   map[string]string `yaml:"undeclared"`
+	InternalEval map[string]string `yaml:"internal_eval"`
+	FailingEval  map[string]string `yaml:"failing_eval"`
+	MissingID    map[string]string `yaml:"missing_id"`
+}
+
+func doctorDiag(r *model.DoctorReport, code, message, path string, warn bool) {
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Message: message, Path: path, Warning: warn})
+}
+func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport, name, module string, ok bool, detail string) {
+	r.Checks = append(r.Checks, model.DoctorCheck{Name: name, Module: module, Passed: ok, Detail: detail})
+}
+func hasErrors(ds []project.Diagnostic) bool {
+	for _, d := range ds {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func rendered(s string, values map[string]string) string {
+	pairs := []string{}
+	for _, key := range []string{"name", "prefix", "package", "go_module", "module_dir", "other_dir"} {
+		pairs = append(pairs, "{{"+key+"}}", values[key])
+	}
+	return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+func writeCanaryFile(root, dir, path, body string, values map[string]string) error {
+	if filepath.IsAbs(path) || strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Clean(path), "..") {
+		return fmt.Errorf("unsafe canary path %q", path)
+	}
+	full := filepath.Join(root, dir, strings.TrimSuffix(path, ".tmpl"))
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(full, []byte(rendered(body, values)), 0644)
+}
+func readCanaryInput(root string) (canaryMap, map[string]string, error) {
+	var maps canaryMap
+	raw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary canaries.yaml: %w", e)
+	}
+	if e = yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &maps); e != nil {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary canaries.yaml: %w", e)
+	}
+	if maps.Version != 1 {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary canaries.yaml: version 1 required")
+	}
+	for name, m := range map[string]map[string]string{"baseline": maps.Baseline, "undeclared": maps.Undeclared, "internal_eval": maps.InternalEval, "failing_eval": maps.FailingEval, "missing_id": maps.MissingID} {
+		if len(m) == 0 {
+			return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary %s map missing", name)
+		}
+	}
+	templates := map[string]string{}
+	base := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/templates/module")
+	e = filepath.WalkDir(base, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		rel, e := filepath.Rel(base, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		data, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		templates[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = string(data)
+		return nil
+	})
+	if e != nil {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("module template: %w", e)
+	}
+	if _, ok := templates["SPEC.md"]; !ok {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md missing")
+	}
+	return maps, templates, nil
+}
+func doctorScratch(root string) (string, string, func(), error) {
+	repo, e := gitstore.Inspect(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	common := repo.CommonDir
+	if !filepath.IsAbs(common) {
+		common = filepath.Join(root, common)
+	}
+	common, e = filepath.EvalSymlinks(common)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	base := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees")
+	if e = os.MkdirAll(base, 0755); e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	scratch, e := os.MkdirTemp(base, "doctor-")
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	os.Remove(scratch)
+	if _, e = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "add", "--detach", scratch, "HEAD"); e != nil {
+		os.RemoveAll(scratch)
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	clean := func() {
+		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "remove", "--force", scratch)
+		_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch)
+		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "prune")
+	}
+	// Setup may need project inputs that are present but not tracked yet.
+	_ = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		rel, e := filepath.Rel(root, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if rel == ".git" || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".git"+string(filepath.Separator)) || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".fireweed/runs") {
+			if d.IsDir() {
+				return filepath.SkipDir
+			}
+			return nil
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if _, e := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(scratch, rel)); e == nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".fireweed") {
+			data, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+			if e == nil {
+				_ = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(filepath.Join(scratch, rel)), 0755)
+				_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(scratch, rel), data, 0644)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	return scratch, common, clean, nil
+}
+func doctorWarnings(root string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
+	data, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "AGENTS.md"))
+	if e != nil || !strings.Contains(string(data), doctorGuidance) {
+		doctorDiag(r, "C16", "AGENTS.md managed guidance is missing or stale", "AGENTS.md", true)
+	}
+	base := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/playbooks")
+	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(base)
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		name := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md")
+		current, e := assets.Playbook(name)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(current))
+		raw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(base, entry.Name()))
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if e != nil || stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["embedded_base"]) != hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) {
+			doctorDiag(r, "C16", name+" playbook embedded_base is missing or stale", filepath.Join(".fireweed/playbooks", entry.Name()), true)
+		}
+	}
+}
+func Doctor(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest) model.DoctorReport {
+	r := model.DoctorReport{}
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Check(req.Root)...)
+	doctorWarnings(req.Root, &r)
+	if hasErrors(r.Diagnostics) {
+		return r
+	}
+	scratch, common, clean, e := doctorScratch(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "scratch worktree: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	defer clean()
+	snap, e := project.Load(scratch)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "scratch project: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	if h := hook(snap.Config, "setup"); h != nil {
+		c, e := parseCommand(h)
+		if e == nil {
+			p := runCommand(ctx, c, scratch, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": req.Bin}, req.Timeout)
+			e = p.err
+			if e == nil && p.exit != 0 {
+				e = fmt.Errorf("exit %d: %s", p.exit, p.stderr)
+			}
+		}
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "setup hook failed: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+			return r
+		}
+	}
+	maps, templates, e := readCanaryInput(scratch)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", e.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	goModule := ""
+	if data, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(scratch, "go.mod")); e == nil {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "module ") {
+				goModule = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "module "))
+				break
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	canaries := []project.Module{}
+	for i, name := range []string{"doctorcanarya", "doctorcanaryb"} {
+		prefix := []string{"DCA", "DCB"}[i]
+		dir := "packages/" + name
+		other := "packages/" + []string{"doctorcanaryb", "doctorcanarya"}[i]
+		values := map[string]string{"name": name, "prefix": prefix, "package": name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": dir, "other_dir": other}
+		for path, body := range templates {
+			if e = writeCanaryFile(scratch, dir, path, body, values); e != nil {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if e == nil {
+			for path, body := range maps.Baseline {
+				e = writeCanaryFile(scratch, dir, path, body, values)
+				if e != nil {
+					break
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "module template: "+e.Error(), pathJoin(dir, "SPEC.md"), false)
+			return r
+		}
+		specRaw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(scratch, dir, "SPEC.md"))
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "module template SPEC.md: "+e.Error(), dir+"/SPEC.md", false)
+			return r
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(specRaw))
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "module template SPEC.md: "+e.Error(), dir+"/SPEC.md", false)
+			return r
+		}
+		m := project.Module{Name: name, IDPrefix: prefix, Dir: dir, Document: doc}
+		if len(snap.Modules) > 0 {
+			m.Zones = snap.Modules[0].Zones
+		}
+		canaries = append(canaries, m)
+	}
+	// Make canaries visible to project loading and to FIREWEED_BIN modules --json.
+	configPath := filepath.Join(scratch, "fireweed.yaml")
+	raw, _ := os.ReadFile(configPath)
+	var config map[string]any
+	if yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &config) == nil {
+		modules := stringsValue(config["modules"])
+		modules = append(modules, canaries[0].Dir, canaries[1].Dir)
+		config["modules"] = modules
+		if output, e := yaml.Marshal(config); e == nil {
+			_ = os.WriteFile(configPath, output, 0644)
+		}
+	}
+	snap.Modules = append(snap.Modules, canaries...)
+	boundaryDiags, boundaryErr := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+	for _, d := range boundaryDiags {
+		if d.Warning || d.Code == "X02" {
+			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
+		}
+	}
+	variants := []struct {
+		kind, label string
+		h           any
+	}{}
+	for _, kind := range []string{"eval", "boundaries"} {
+		if h := hook(snap.Config, kind); h != nil {
+			variants = append(variants, struct {
+				kind, label string
+				h           any
+			}{kind, "global " + kind + " hook", h})
+		}
+		for _, m := range snap.Modules[:len(snap.Modules)-2] {
+			if h := moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter, kind); h != nil {
+				variants = append(variants, struct {
+					kind, label string
+					h           any
+				}{kind, m.Name + " " + kind + " override", h})
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	baseline := func(canary project.Module, label string) bool {
+		ok := true
+		for _, v := range variants {
+			if v.kind == "eval" {
+				if e := doctorEval(ctx, snap, canary, v.h, req); e != nil {
+					ok = false
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", label+" "+canary.Name+" "+v.label+": "+e.Error(), "", false)
+				}
+			} else {
+				lines, e := doctorBoundary(ctx, snap, v.h, req)
+				if e != nil || len(lines) > 0 {
+					ok = false
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", label+" "+canary.Name+" "+v.label+": "+fmt.Sprint(e, lines), "", false)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if boundaryErr != nil {
+			ok = false
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", label+" "+canary.Name+" boundaries hook: "+boundaryErr.Error(), "", false)
+		}
+		doctorCheck(&r, label, canary.Name, ok, "")
+		return ok
+	}
+	for _, m := range canaries {
+		if !baseline(m, "baseline") {
+			return r
+		}
+	}
+	for i, name := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id"} {
+		m := canaries[i%2]
+		values := map[string]string{"name": m.Name, "prefix": m.IDPrefix, "package": m.Name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": m.Dir, "other_dir": canaries[(i+1)%2].Dir}
+		var files map[string]string
+		switch name {
+		case "undeclared":
+			files = maps.Undeclared
+		case "internal_eval":
+			files = maps.InternalEval
+		case "failing_eval":
+			files = maps.FailingEval
+		case "missing_id":
+			files = maps.MissingID
+		}
+		paths := []string{}
+		for p, b := range files {
+			if e = writeCanaryFile(scratch, m.Dir, p, b, values); e != nil {
+				doctorDiag(&r, "C14", name+" canary file: "+e.Error(), p, false)
+			}
+			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(scratch, m.Dir, strings.TrimSuffix(p, ".tmpl")))
+		}
+		for _, v := range variants {
+			if name == "undeclared" || name == "internal_eval" {
+				if v.kind != "boundaries" {
+					continue
+				}
+				lines, e := doctorBoundary(ctx, snap, v.h, req)
+				detected := false
+				for _, line := range lines {
+					if strings.HasPrefix(line, m.Name+":") && (name != "internal_eval" || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(line), "interface")) {
+						detected = true
+					}
+				}
+				pass := e == nil && detected
+				doctorCheck(&r, name+" "+v.label, m.Name, pass, "")
+				if !pass {
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", name+" "+m.Name+" "+v.label+" missed canary", "", false)
+				}
+			} else {
+				if v.kind != "eval" {
+					continue
+				}
+				detected := doctorEvalCanary(ctx, snap, m, v.h, req, name)
+				doctorCheck(&r, name+" "+v.label, m.Name, detected, "")
+				if !detected {
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", name+" "+m.Name+" "+v.label+" missed canary", "", false)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		for _, p := range paths {
+			_ = os.Remove(p)
+		}
+		baseline(m, "recovery "+name)
+	}
+	if !req.NoAgent {
+		doctorAgents(ctx, req, scratch, common, snap.Config, &r)
+	}
+	return r
+}
+func pathJoin(a, b string) string { return filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(a, b)) }
+func doctorEval(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, h any, req model.DoctorRequest) error {
+	fm := m.Document.Frontmatter
+	if fm == nil {
+		fm = map[string]any{}
+	}
+	copyFM := map[string]any{}
+	for k, v := range fm {
+		copyFM[k] = v
+	}
+	copyFM["hooks"] = map[string]any{"eval": h}
+	m.Document.Frontmatter = copyFM
+	snap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
+	rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	specs, e := moduleSpecs(m)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = RequireCoverage(rep, specs); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return RequirePass(rep, specs)
+}
+func doctorEvalCanary(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, h any, req model.DoctorRequest, name string) bool {
+	fm := map[string]any{}
+	for k, v := range m.Document.Frontmatter {
+		fm[k] = v
+	}
+	fm["hooks"] = map[string]any{"eval": h}
+	m.Document.Frontmatter = fm
+	snap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
+	rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+	if name == "failing_eval" {
+		return e == nil && rep.HookExit != 0 && RequireFailFirst(rep, []string{m.IDPrefix + "-001"}, nil) == nil
+	}
+	return e != nil && strings.Contains(e.Error(), "references unknown spec ID")
+}
+func doctorBoundary(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, h any, req model.DoctorRequest) ([]string, error) {
+	c, e := parseCommand(h)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	p := runCommand(ctx, c, snap.Root, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": req.Bin}, req.Timeout)
+	if p.err != nil {
+		var ex interface{ ExitCode() int }
+		if !errors.As(p.err, &ex) {
+			return nil, p.err
+		}
+	}
+	lines := []string{}
+	for _, s := range strings.Split(p.stdout+"\n"+p.stderr, "\n") {
+		s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
+		if s != "" {
+			lines = append(lines, s)
+		}
+	}
+	return lines, nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor_agents.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor_agents.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e9e989fb31b887c21f8e52ad19619fee4e7a0e6d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor_agents.go
@@ -0,0 +1,115 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+)
+
+func tail20(s string) string {
+	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(s, "\n"), "\n")
+	if len(lines) > 20 {
+		lines = lines[len(lines)-20:]
+	}
+	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
+}
+func doctorAgents(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, scratch, common string, config map[string]any, r *model.DoctorReport) {
+	runRoot := filepath.Join(req.Root, ".fireweed", "runs")
+	_ = os.MkdirAll(runRoot, 0755)
+	runDir, e := os.MkdirTemp(runRoot, "doctor-")
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(r, "C15", "probe logs: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+		return
+	}
+	agent := object(config["agent"])
+	audit := object(config["audit"])
+	wrapperValue := agent["wrap"]
+	for _, role := range []string{"worker", "audit"} {
+		selected := agent["command"]
+		if role == "audit" {
+			selected = audit["command"]
+			if selected == nil {
+				selected = agent["command"]
+				doctorDiag(r, "C15", "audit shares worker command; shared-command blind spot", "", true)
+			}
+		}
+		c, e := parseCommand(selected)
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(r, "C15", role+" command: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+			doctorCheck(r, role, "", false, e.Error())
+			continue
+		}
+		var wrap command
+		if wrapperValue != nil {
+			wrap, e = parseCommand(wrapperValue)
+			if e != nil {
+				doctorDiag(r, "C15", role+" wrapper: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+				doctorCheck(r, role, "", false, e.Error())
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		promptFile := ""
+		if c.uses("prompt_file") || wrap.uses("prompt_file") {
+			f, e := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-doctor-prompt-*")
+			if e != nil {
+				doctorDiag(r, "C15", role+" prompt file: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+				continue
+			}
+			promptFile = f.Name()
+			_, _ = f.WriteString(doctorPrompt)
+			_ = f.Close()
+		}
+		values := map[string]string{"prompt": doctorPrompt, "prompt_file": promptFile, "git_common_dir": common}
+		c = c.expanded(values)
+		if wrapperValue != nil {
+			wrap = wrap.expanded(values)
+			if wrap.isShell {
+				if c.isShell {
+					wrap.shell += " sh -c " + shellQuote(c.shell)
+				} else {
+					for _, arg := range c.argv {
+						wrap.shell += " " + shellQuote(arg)
+					}
+				}
+			} else {
+				if c.isShell {
+					wrap.argv = append(wrap.argv, "sh", "-c", c.shell)
+				} else {
+					wrap.argv = append(wrap.argv, c.argv...)
+				}
+			}
+			c = wrap
+		}
+		timeout := req.Timeout
+		if timeout <= 0 {
+			timeout = 3 * time.Minute
+		}
+		p := runCommand(ctx, c, scratch, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": req.Bin}, timeout)
+		if promptFile != "" {
+			_ = os.Remove(promptFile)
+		}
+		path := filepath.Join(runDir, "doctor-"+role+"-1.log")
+		_ = os.WriteFile(path, []byte(p.stdout+p.stderr), 0644)
+		detail := "log: " + path
+		replied := false
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(p.stdout, "\n") { if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK" { replied = true } }
+		success := p.err == nil && p.exit == 0 && replied
+		doctorCheck(r, role, "", success, detail)
+		if !success {
+			tail := tail20(p.stdout + "\n" + p.stderr)
+			kind := "command failure"
+			for _, pattern := range stringsValue(config["limit_patterns"]) {
+				if pattern != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(tail), strings.ToLower(pattern)) {
+					kind = "usage limit"
+					break
+				}
+			}
+			doctorDiag(r, "C15", fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s: %v exit %d\n%s", role, kind, c.display(), p.err, p.exit, tail), path, false)
+		}
+	}
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/history.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/history.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..db5f1c7ceb3191ca7ed104e5458c43a48ca908f9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/history.go
@@ -0,0 +1,269 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func gitOutput(root string, args ...string) (string, error) {
+	c := exec.Command("git", append([]string{"-C", root}, args...)...)
+	b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), e, b)
+	}
+	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
+}
+func gitPaths(root, rev string) ([]string, error) {
+	s, e := gitOutput(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", rev)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	if s == "" {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	return strings.Split(s, "\n"), nil
+}
+func changeStates(root, rev string) (map[string]struct{ path, phase, module string }, error) {
+	out := map[string]struct{ path, phase, module string }{}
+	if rev == "" {
+		return out, nil
+	}
+	paths, e := gitPaths(root, rev)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	for _, p := range paths {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(p, "changes/") || !strings.HasSuffix(p, ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		raw, e := gitOutput(root, "show", rev+":"+p)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		out[filepath.Base(p)] = struct{ path, phase, module string }{p, stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]), stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["module"])}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+type fileDelta struct{ status, path, old string }
+
+func deltas(root, parent, child string, merge bool) ([]fileDelta, error) {
+	var args []string
+	if merge {
+		args = []string{"diff-tree", "--cc", "--name-only", "-r", child}
+	} else {
+		args = []string{"diff", "--name-status", "-M", parent, child}
+	}
+	raw, e := gitOutput(root, args...)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []fileDelta{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(raw, "\n") {
+		if line == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if merge {
+			if len(line) == 40 && line == child {
+				continue
+			}
+			out = append(out, fileDelta{status: "M", path: line})
+			continue
+		}
+		f := strings.Split(line, "\t")
+		if len(f) < 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		d := fileDelta{status: f[0], path: f[1]}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(d.status, "R") && len(f) >= 3 {
+			d.old = f[1]
+			d.path = f[2]
+		}
+		out = append(out, d)
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func findModule(s project.Snapshot, path string) *project.Module {
+	for i := range s.Modules {
+		if pathUnder(path, s.Modules[i].Dir) {
+			return &s.Modules[i]
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func zoneIn(s project.Snapshot, path string, kind string) bool {
+	m := findModule(s, path)
+	if m == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	rel := strings.TrimPrefix(path, m.Dir+"/")
+	return contracts.ResolveZone(rel, m.Zones) == kind
+}
+func History(root, revisionRange string) (model.HistoryReport, error) {
+	result := model.HistoryReport{Commits: []string{}}
+	if revisionRange == "" {
+		snap, e := project.Load(root)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		base := stringValue(snap.Config["base"])
+		if base == "" {
+			return result, fmt.Errorf("missing configured base")
+		}
+		resolved, e := gitOutput(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", base)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		merge, e := gitOutput(root, "merge-base", "HEAD", resolved)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		revisionRange = merge + "..HEAD"
+	}
+	raw, e := gitOutput(root, "rev-list", "--topo-order", "--reverse", revisionRange)
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	if raw == "" {
+		return result, nil
+	}
+	result.Commits = strings.Split(raw, "\n")
+	for _, oid := range result.Commits {
+		parentLine, e := gitOutput(root, "rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		fields := strings.Fields(parentLine)
+		parents := fields[1:]
+		before := ""
+		if len(parents) > 0 {
+			before = parents[0]
+		}
+		afterSnap, e := project.LoadAt(root, oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		var beforeSnap project.Snapshot
+		if before != "" {
+			beforeSnap, e = project.LoadAt(root, before)
+			if e != nil {
+				return result, e
+			}
+		}
+		beforeChanges, e := changeStates(root, before)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		afterChanges, e := changeStates(root, oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		parentStates := []map[string]struct{ path, phase, module string }{}
+		for _, p := range parents {
+			states, e := changeStates(root, p)
+			if e != nil {
+				return result, e
+			}
+			parentStates = append(parentStates, states)
+		}
+		worker := false
+		applied := false
+		squashed := false
+		workerModule := ""
+		projected := afterSnap
+		for name, state := range afterChanges {
+			newPhase := true
+			hadImpl := false
+			for _, p := range parentStates {
+				if previous, ok := p[name]; ok {
+					if previous.phase == state.phase {
+						newPhase = false
+					}
+					if previous.phase == "impl" {
+						hadImpl = true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+			if !newPhase {
+				continue
+			}
+			if state.phase == "audit" || state.phase == "evals" || state.phase == "impl" || state.phase == "applied" {
+				worker = true
+				workerModule = state.module
+			}
+			if state.phase == "applied" {
+				applied = hadImpl
+				if !hadImpl {
+					squashed = true
+					result.Squashed = append(result.Squashed, model.SquashedChange{Commit: oid, Change: state.path})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		_ = beforeChanges
+		ds, e := deltas(root, before, oid, len(parents) > 1)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		if len(parents) > 1 {
+			for _, p := range parents {
+				extra, e := deltas(root, p, oid, false)
+				if e != nil {
+					return result, e
+				}
+				for _, d := range extra {
+					if zoneIn(beforeSnap, d.path, "append_only") || zoneIn(afterSnap, d.path, "append_only") {
+						ds = append(ds, d)
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		seen := map[string]bool{}
+		add := func(code, path string) {
+			key := code + "|" + path
+			if seen[key] {
+				return
+			}
+			seen[key] = true
+			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Path: path, Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s in commit %s", code, oid)})
+		}
+		for _, d := range ds {
+			paths := []string{d.path}
+			if d.old != "" {
+				paths = append(paths, d.old)
+			}
+			for _, path := range paths {
+				if path == "" {
+					continue
+				}
+				if worker && !squashed {
+					if strings.HasPrefix(path, ".fireweed/playbooks/") || matchAny(stringsValue(beforeSnap.Config["protected"]), path) || matchAny(stringsValue(afterSnap.Config["protected"]), path) {
+						add("H01", path)
+					}
+					if applied {
+						m := findModule(projected, path)
+						if m != nil && m.Name == workerModule && (zoneIn(beforeSnap, path, "evals") || zoneIn(beforeSnap, path, "interface") || zoneIn(projected, path, "evals") || zoneIn(projected, path, "interface")) {
+							add("H02", path)
+						}
+					}
+				}
+				if (zoneIn(beforeSnap, path, "append_only") || zoneIn(afterSnap, path, "append_only")) && existsAt(root, before, path) {
+					add("H03", path)
+				}
+				if strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") && d.status != "D" && path == d.path && existsAt(root, before, path) {
+					add("H04", path)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return result, nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/hooks.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/hooks.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..5d9b00cf4a8972f7b13f6fbf3a65ce403740c38c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/hooks.go
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module)([]contracts.Item,error){body,ok:=contracts.Section(m.Document.Body,"Specs");if !ok{return nil,nil};items,err:=contracts.ParseItems(body);if err!=nil {msg:=err.Error();if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(msg),"duplicate") {return nil,coded("C05","%s",msg)};return nil,coded("C03","%s",msg)};return items,nil}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, req model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+ var m *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module {m=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}};if m==nil{return model.Report{},coded("U02","unknown module %q",req.Module)}
+ specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*m);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+ h:=moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter,"eval");if h==nil {h=hook(req.Snapshot.Config,"eval")};if h==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",m.Name)}
+ c,err:=parseCommand(h);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","%v",err)}
+ f,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};reportPath:=f.Name();f.Close();os.Remove(reportPath);defer os.Remove(reportPath)
+ values:=map[string]string{"module":m.Name,"module_dir":m.Dir,"report":reportPath};c=c.expanded(values)
+ r:=runCommand(ctx,c,req.Snapshot.Root,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":req.Bin},req.Timeout)
+ report:=model.Report{HookExit:r.exit,Stdout:r.stdout,Stderr:r.stderr}
+ if r.err!=nil {var exit *os.PathError;var ex interface{ ExitCode() int };if errors.As(r.err,&exit)||!errors.As(r.err,&ex){return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",r.err)}}
+ data,err:=os.ReadFile(reportPath);if err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","read JUnit report: %v",err)}
+ parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+ failed:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"{failed=true;break}}
+ if (r.exit==0)==failed {return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",r.exit)}
+ return report,nil
+}
+
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context,req model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+ snap:=req.Snapshot;diags:=[]project.Diagnostic{};var causes []error
+ baseline:=map[string]bool{};if data,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root,".fireweed","boundaries-baseline"));e==nil {for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(data),"\n") {if line!="" {baseline[line]=true}}}
+ global:=hook(snap.Config,"boundaries")
+ run:=func(label string,h any){c,e:=parseCommand(h);if e!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:label+": "+e.Error()});causes=append(causes,e);return};r:=runCommand(ctx,c.expanded(map[string]string{}),snap.Root,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":req.Bin},req.Timeout);if r.err!=nil {var ex interface{ExitCode()int};if !errors.As(r.err,&ex)||ctx.Err()!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:label+": "+r.err.Error()});causes=append(causes,r.err);return}}
+  for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr,"\n"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line==""||baseline[line] {continue};suppressed:=false;for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);if reason!=""&&strings.HasPrefix(line,m.Name+":") {suppressed=true;break}};if suppressed{continue};diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X01",Message:line});causes=append(causes,fmt.Errorf("%s",line))}
+ }
+ if global!=nil {run("global boundaries hook",global)}
+ for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);if reason!="" {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X03",Message:m.Name+": boundaries opt out: "+reason,Warning:true})}
+  override:=moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter,"boundaries");if override!=nil {run(m.Name+" boundaries hook",override)} else if global==nil {if len(m.Zones.Disposable)>0&&reason=="" {msg:=m.Name+": missing boundaries hook";diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:msg});causes=append(causes,errors.New(msg))} else {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X04",Message:m.Name+": no boundary enforcement required",Warning:true})}}
+ }
+ return diags,errors.Join(causes...)
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e38ec567f27154538ca365b10d6f0cc40263fa57
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go
@@ -0,0 +1,183 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"encoding/xml"
+	"io"
+	"regexp"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitCase struct {
+	Name      string         `xml:"name,attr"`
+	Classname string         `xml:"classname,attr"`
+	Time      string         `xml:"time,attr"`
+	Failure   []junitProblem `xml:"failure"`
+	Error     []junitProblem `xml:"error"`
+	Skipped   []struct{}     `xml:"skipped"`
+}
+type junitProblem struct {
+	Message string `xml:"message,attr"`
+	Body    string `xml:",chardata"`
+}
+
+var specToken = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(^|[^a-z0-9])([a-z]+[-_]?[0-9]{3,})([^0-9]|$)`)
+
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte, specs []contracts.Item) (model.Report, error) {
+	dec := xml.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)))
+	root, err := dec.Token()
+	if err != nil {
+		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", err)
+	}
+	start, ok := root.(xml.StartElement)
+	if !ok || (start.Name.Local != "testsuite" && start.Name.Local != "testsuites") {
+		name := ""
+		if ok {
+			name = start.Name.Local
+		}
+		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "invalid JUnit root %q", name)
+	}
+	report := model.Report{Cases: []model.Case{}}
+	depth := 1
+	for depth > 0 {
+		tok, e := dec.Token()
+		if e != nil {
+			if e == io.EOF {
+				return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: unexpected EOF")
+			}
+			return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", e)
+		}
+		switch v := tok.(type) {
+		case xml.StartElement:
+			depth++
+			if v.Name.Local != "testcase" {
+				continue
+			}
+			var raw junitCase
+			if e := dec.DecodeElement(&raw, &v); e != nil {
+				return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", e)
+			}
+			depth--
+			c := model.Case{Name: raw.Name, Classname: raw.Classname, Result: "pass"}
+			if raw.Time != "" {
+				c.Seconds, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(raw.Time, 64)
+			}
+			if len(raw.Skipped) > 0 {
+				c.Result = "skip"
+			}
+			if len(raw.Failure) > 0 || len(raw.Error) > 0 {
+				c.Result = "fail"
+				parts := []string{}
+				for _, p := range append(raw.Failure, raw.Error...) {
+					if s := strings.TrimSpace(p.Message); s != "" {
+						parts = append(parts, s)
+					}
+					if s := strings.TrimSpace(p.Body); s != "" {
+						parts = append(parts, s)
+					}
+				}
+				c.Failure = strings.Join(parts, "\n")
+			}
+					if strings.ContainsAny(m[2], "-_") {
+						return report, coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, m[2])
+					}
+					for _, s := range specs {
+				if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID, c.Name, c.Classname) {
+					c.IDs = append(c.IDs, s.ID)
+				}
+			}
+			if len(c.IDs) == 0 {
+				for _, candidate := range []string{c.Name, c.Classname} {
+					for _, m := range specToken.FindAllStringSubmatch(candidate, -1) {
+						id := strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(m[2], "_", "-"))
+						for _, s := range specs {
+							prefix := strings.SplitN(strings.ToUpper(s.ID), "-", 2)[0]
+							if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ReplaceAll(id, "-", ""), prefix) {
+								return report, coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, m[2])
+							}
+						}
+					}
+				}
+				return report, coded("C11", "testcase %q has no known spec ID", c.Name)
+			}
+			report.Seconds += c.Seconds
+			report.Cases = append(report.Cases, c)
+		case xml.EndElement:
+			depth--
+		}
+	}
+	if _, e := dec.Token(); e != io.EOF {
+		if e != nil {
+			return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", e)
+		}
+		return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: trailing XML")
+	}
+	return report, nil
+}
+func hasID(ids []string, id string) bool {
+	for _, x := range ids {
+		if x == id {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func exemptTag(tag string) bool {
+	s := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
+	return strings.HasPrefix(s, "review") || strings.HasPrefix(s, "quarantine")
+}
+func RequireCoverage(report model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
+	for _, s := range specs {
+		if exemptTag(s.Tag) {
+			continue
+		}
+		found := false
+		for _, c := range report.Cases {
+			if c.Result != "skip" && hasID(c.IDs, s.ID) {
+				found = true
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if !found {
+			return coded("C10", "no coverage for %s", s.ID)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func RequireFailFirst(report model.Report, ids, already []string) error {
+	for _, id := range ids {
+		if hasID(already, id) {
+			continue
+		}
+		ok := false
+		for _, c := range report.Cases {
+			if c.Result == "fail" && hasID(c.IDs, id) {
+				ok = true
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if !ok {
+			return coded("P2-01", "no fail-first case for %s", id)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func RequirePass(report model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
+	for _, c := range report.Cases {
+		if c.Result != "fail" {
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, id := range c.IDs {
+			for _, s := range specs {
+				if s.ID == id && !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(s.Tag), "quarantine") {
+					return coded("E01", "failed case %q for %s", c.Name, id)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+

+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func pathUnder(path,dir string) bool {path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));dir=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(dir)),"/");return strings.HasPrefix(path,dir+"/")}
+func matchAny(globs []string,path string) bool {for _,g:=range globs {if contracts.MatchGlob(g,path){return true}};return false}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev==""{return false};_,err:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,rev,path);return err==nil}
+func Zones(req model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {
+ var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module {target=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+ bad:=[]project.Diagnostic{};reject:=func(path,reason string){bad=append(bad,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:reason})}
+ check:=func(path string,src bool) {if path=="" {return};path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));if path==req.ChangePath {return}
+  if pathUnder(path,"changes") {reject(path,"other change file");return}
+  if pathUnder(path,".fireweed")||matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path) {reject(path,"protected path");return}
+  for _,m:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if path==m.Dir+"/SPEC.md" {reject(path,"module SPEC.md");return};if pathUnder(path,m.Dir)&&m.Name!=req.Module {reject(path,"another module");return}}
+  if req.Phase=="audit" {reject(path,"audit permits only current change");return}
+  if target!=nil&&pathUnder(path,target.Dir) {rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(target.Dir,"/")+"/");zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones);switch zone {
+   case "protected":reject(path,"protected zone")
+   case "evals":if req.Phase!="evals" {reject(path,"evals zone")}
+   case "interface":if req.Phase!="evals"||!req.InterfaceDeclared {reject(path,"interface zone")}
+   case "append_only":if req.Phase!="impl"||src||existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path) {reject(path,"append_only zone")}
+   case "disposable":if req.Phase=="evals"&&(src||existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path)){reject(path,"existing disposable file")}
+   case "preserve":if req.Phase=="evals" {reject(path,"preserve zone")}
+   }
+   return
+  }
+  if !matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),path){reject(path,"outside worker_writable")}
+ }
+ for _,c:=range req.Changes {if c.OldPath!="" {check(c.OldPath,true)};check(c.Path,false)}
+ return bad
+}

	switch x := v.(type) {

func gitOutput(root string, args ...string) (string, error) {

	if e != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), e, b)
	}

	s, e := gitOutput(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", rev)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	if s == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return strings.Split(s, "\n"), nil

func moduleSpecs(m project.Module) ([]contracts.Item, error) {
	body, ok := contracts.Section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil
	}
	items, err := contracts.ParseItems(body)
	if err != nil {
		msg := err.Error()
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(msg), "duplicate") {
			return nil, coded("C05", "%s", msg)
		}
		return nil, coded("C03", "%s", msg)
	}
	return items, nil
}

}
func pathJoin(a, b string) string { return filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(a, b)) }
func doctorEval(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, h any, req model.DoctorRequest) error {
	fm := m.Document.Frontmatter
	if fm == nil {
		fm = map[string]any{}
	}
	copyFM := map[string]any{}
	for k, v := range fm {
		copyFM[k] = v
	}
	copyFM["hooks"] = map[string]any{"eval": h}
	m.Document.Frontmatter = copyFM
	snap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
	rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	specs, e := moduleSpecs(m)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if e = RequireCoverage(rep, specs); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return RequirePass(rep, specs)
}
func doctorEvalCanary(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, h any, req model.DoctorRequest, name string) bool {
	fm := map[string]any{}
	for k, v := range m.Document.Frontmatter {
		fm[k] = v
	}
	fm["hooks"] = map[string]any{"eval": h}
	m.Document.Frontmatter = fm
	snap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
	rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
	if name == "failing_eval" {
		return e == nil && rep.HookExit != 0 && RequireFailFirst(rep, []string{m.IDPrefix + "-001"}, nil) == nil
	}
	return e != nil && strings.Contains(e.Error(), "references unknown spec ID")
}
func doctorBoundary(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, h any, req model.DoctorRequest) ([]string, error) {
	c, e := parseCommand(h)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	p := runCommand(ctx, c, snap.Root, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": req.Bin}, req.Timeout)
	if p.err != nil {
		var ex interface{ ExitCode() int }
		if !errors.As(p.err, &ex) {
			return nil, p.err
		}
	}
	lines := []string{}
	for _, s := range strings.Split(p.stdout+"\n"+p.stderr, "\n") {
		s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
		if s != "" {
			lines = append(lines, s)
		}
	}
	return lines, nil
}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func object(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func stringValue(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsValue(v any) []string { switch x:=v.(type) {case []string: return x; case []any: out:=[]string{}; for _,e:=range x { if s,ok:=e.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)} }; return out }; return nil }
+func hook(config map[string]any, key string) any { return object(config["hooks"])[key] }
+func moduleHook(fm map[string]any,key string) any { return object(fm["hooks"])[key] }
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\\''")+"'" }
+
+type command struct { shell string; argv []string; isShell bool }
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {
+ switch x:=v.(type) {
+ case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")}; return command{shell:x,isShell:true},nil
+ case []string: if len(x)==0 || x[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; return command{argv:append([]string(nil),x...)},nil
+ case []any: if len(x)==0 {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; a:=make([]string,len(x));for i,e:=range x {s,ok:=e.(string); if !ok {return command{},fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")};a[i]=s};if a[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:a},nil
+ default: return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")
+ }
+}
+func expand(s string, values map[string]string, quote bool) string {
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} {if v,ok:=values[k];ok {if quote {v=shellQuote(v)}; pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)}}
+ return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+func (c command) expanded(values map[string]string) command {
+ if c.isShell {c.shell=expand(c.shell,values,true)} else {for i:=range c.argv {c.argv[i]=expand(c.argv[i],values,false)}};return c
+}
+func (c command) uses(key string) bool { p:="{"+key+"}";if c.isShell {return strings.Contains(c.shell,p)};for _,s:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(s,p){return true}};return false }
+func (c command) display() string {if c.isShell{return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type processResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) processResult {
+ if timeout>0 {var cancel context.CancelFunc;ctx,cancel=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()}
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.isShell {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,"sh","-c",c.shell)} else {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,c.argv[0],c.argv[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir; cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err==nil {stop:=context.AfterFunc(ctx,func(){if cmd.Process!=nil { _=syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL) }});err=cmd.Wait();stop()}
+ r:=processResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}
+ if cmd.ProcessState!=nil {r.exit=cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode()}
+ if ctx.Err()!=nil {r.err=ctx.Err()}
+ return r
+}
+func inside(root,path string) string {if filepath.IsAbs(path){return path};return filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path))}

+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+)
+
+const doctorPrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
+const doctorGuidance = "<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->\n"
+
+type canaryMap struct {
+	Version      int               `yaml:"version"`
+	Baseline     map[string]string `yaml:"baseline"`
+	Undeclared   map[string]string `yaml:"undeclared"`
+	InternalEval map[string]string `yaml:"internal_eval"`
+	FailingEval  map[string]string `yaml:"failing_eval"`
+	MissingID    map[string]string `yaml:"missing_id"`
+}
+
+func doctorDiag(r *model.DoctorReport, code, message, path string, warn bool) {
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Message: message, Path: path, Warning: warn})
+}
+func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport, name, module string, ok bool, detail string) {
+	r.Checks = append(r.Checks, model.DoctorCheck{Name: name, Module: module, Passed: ok, Detail: detail})
+}
+func hasErrors(ds []project.Diagnostic) bool {
+	for _, d := range ds {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func rendered(s string, values map[string]string) string {
+	pairs := []string{}
+	for _, key := range []string{"name", "prefix", "package", "go_module", "module_dir", "other_dir"} {
+		pairs = append(pairs, "{{"+key+"}}", values[key])
+	}
+	return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+func writeCanaryFile(root, dir, path, body string, values map[string]string) error {
+	if filepath.IsAbs(path) || strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Clean(path), "..") {
+		return fmt.Errorf("unsafe canary path %q", path)
+	}
+	full := filepath.Join(root, dir, strings.TrimSuffix(path, ".tmpl"))
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(full, []byte(rendered(body, values)), 0644)
+}
+func readCanaryInput(root string) (canaryMap, map[string]string, error) {
+	var maps canaryMap
+	raw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary canaries.yaml: %w", e)
+	}
+	if e = yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &maps); e != nil {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary canaries.yaml: %w", e)
+	}
+	if maps.Version != 1 {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary canaries.yaml: version 1 required")
+	}
+	for name, m := range map[string]map[string]string{"baseline": maps.Baseline, "undeclared": maps.Undeclared, "internal_eval": maps.InternalEval, "failing_eval": maps.FailingEval, "missing_id": maps.MissingID} {
+		if len(m) == 0 {
+			return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary %s map missing", name)
+		}
+	}
+	templates := map[string]string{}
+	base := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/templates/module")
+	e = filepath.WalkDir(base, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		rel, e := filepath.Rel(base, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		data, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		templates[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = string(data)
+		return nil
+	})
+	if e != nil {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("module template: %w", e)
+	}
+	if _, ok := templates["SPEC.md"]; !ok {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md missing")
+	}
+	return maps, templates, nil
+}
+func doctorScratch(root string) (string, string, func(), error) {
+	repo, e := gitstore.Inspect(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	common := repo.CommonDir
+	if !filepath.IsAbs(common) {
+		common = filepath.Join(root, common)
+	}
+	common, e = filepath.EvalSymlinks(common)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	base := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees")
+	if e = os.MkdirAll(base, 0755); e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	scratch, e := os.MkdirTemp(base, "doctor-")
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	os.Remove(scratch)
+	if _, e = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "add", "--detach", scratch, "HEAD"); e != nil {
+		os.RemoveAll(scratch)
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	clean := func() {
+		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "remove", "--force", scratch)
+		_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch)
+		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "prune")
+	}
+	// Setup may need project inputs that are present but not tracked yet.
+	_ = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		rel, e := filepath.Rel(root, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if rel == ".git" || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".git"+string(filepath.Separator)) || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".fireweed/runs") {
+			if d.IsDir() {
+				return filepath.SkipDir
+			}
+			return nil
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if _, e := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(scratch, rel)); e == nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".fireweed") {
+			data, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+			if e == nil {
+				_ = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(filepath.Join(scratch, rel)), 0755)
+				_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(scratch, rel), data, 0644)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	return scratch, common, clean, nil
+}
+func doctorWarnings(root string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
+	data, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "AGENTS.md"))
+	if e != nil || !strings.Contains(string(data), doctorGuidance) {
+		doctorDiag(r, "C16", "AGENTS.md managed guidance is missing or stale", "AGENTS.md", true)
+	}
+	base := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/playbooks")
+	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(base)
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		name := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md")
+		current, e := assets.Playbook(name)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(current))
+		raw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(base, entry.Name()))
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if e != nil || stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["embedded_base"]) != hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) {
+			doctorDiag(r, "C16", name+" playbook embedded_base is missing or stale", filepath.Join(".fireweed/playbooks", entry.Name()), true)
+		}
+	}
+}
+func Doctor(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest) model.DoctorReport {
+	r := model.DoctorReport{}
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Check(req.Root)...)
+	doctorWarnings(req.Root, &r)
+	if hasErrors(r.Diagnostics) {
+		return r
+	}
+	scratch, common, clean, e := doctorScratch(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "scratch worktree: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	defer clean()
+	snap, e := project.Load(scratch)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "scratch project: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	if h := hook(snap.Config, "setup"); h != nil {
+		c, e := parseCommand(h)
+		if e == nil {
+			p := runCommand(ctx, c, scratch, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": req.Bin}, req.Timeout)
+			e = p.err
+			if e == nil && p.exit != 0 {
+				e = fmt.Errorf("exit %d: %s", p.exit, p.stderr)
+			}
+		}
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "setup hook failed: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+			return r
+		}
+	}
+	maps, templates, e := readCanaryInput(scratch)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", e.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	goModule := ""
+	if data, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(scratch, "go.mod")); e == nil {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "module ") {
+				goModule = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "module "))
+				break
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	canaries := []project.Module{}
+	for i, name := range []string{"doctorcanarya", "doctorcanaryb"} {
+		prefix := []string{"DCA", "DCB"}[i]
+		dir := "packages/" + name
+		other := "packages/" + []string{"doctorcanaryb", "doctorcanarya"}[i]
+		values := map[string]string{"name": name, "prefix": prefix, "package": name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": dir, "other_dir": other}
+		for path, body := range templates {
+			if e = writeCanaryFile(scratch, dir, path, body, values); e != nil {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if e == nil {
+			for path, body := range maps.Baseline {
+				e = writeCanaryFile(scratch, dir, path, body, values)
+				if e != nil {
+					break
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "module template: "+e.Error(), pathJoin(dir, "SPEC.md"), false)
+			return r
+		}
+		specRaw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(scratch, dir, "SPEC.md"))
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "module template SPEC.md: "+e.Error(), dir+"/SPEC.md", false)
+			return r
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(specRaw))
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "module template SPEC.md: "+e.Error(), dir+"/SPEC.md", false)
+			return r
+		}
+		m := project.Module{Name: name, IDPrefix: prefix, Dir: dir, Document: doc}
+		if len(snap.Modules) > 0 {
+			m.Zones = snap.Modules[0].Zones
+		}
+		canaries = append(canaries, m)
+	}
+	// Make canaries visible to project loading and to FIREWEED_BIN modules --json.
+	configPath := filepath.Join(scratch, "fireweed.yaml")
+	raw, _ := os.ReadFile(configPath)
+	var config map[string]any
+	if yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &config) == nil {
+		modules := stringsValue(config["modules"])
+		for _, canary := range canaries { if !matchAny(modules, canary.Dir) { modules = append(modules, canary.Dir) } }
+		config["modules"] = modules
+		if output, e := yaml.Marshal(config); e == nil {
+			_ = os.WriteFile(configPath, output, 0644)
+		}
+	}
+	realModules := append([]project.Module(nil), snap.Modules...)
+	snap.Modules = append(snap.Modules, canaries...)
+	realSnapshot := snap
+	realSnapshot.Modules = realModules
+	boundaryDiags, boundaryErr := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: realSnapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+	for _, d := range boundaryDiags {
+		if d.Warning || d.Code == "X02" {
+			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
+		}
+	}
+	variants := []struct {
+		kind, label string
+		h           any
+	}{}
+	for _, kind := range []string{"eval", "boundaries"} {
+		if h := hook(snap.Config, kind); h != nil {
+			variants = append(variants, struct {
+				kind, label string
+				h           any
+			}{kind, "global " + kind + " hook", h})
+		}
+		for _, m := range snap.Modules[:len(snap.Modules)-2] {
+			if h := moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter, kind); h != nil {
+				variants = append(variants, struct {
+					kind, label string
+					h           any
+				}{kind, m.Name + " " + kind + " override", h})
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	hasEval := false
+	for _, v := range variants { if v.kind == "eval" { hasEval = true; break } }
+	if !hasEval { doctorDiag(&r,"C14","baseline eval hook missing","",false); return r }
+	baseline := func(canary project.Module, label string) bool {
+		ok := true
+		for _, v := range variants {
+			if v.kind == "eval" {
+				if e := doctorEval(ctx, snap, canary, v.h, req); e != nil {
+					ok = false
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", label+" "+canary.Name+" "+v.label+": "+e.Error(), "", false)
+				}
+			} else {
+				lines, e := doctorBoundary(ctx, snap, v.h, req)
+				if e != nil || len(lines) > 0 {
+					ok = false
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", label+" "+canary.Name+" "+v.label+": "+fmt.Sprint(e, lines), "", false)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if boundaryErr != nil {
+			ok = false
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", label+" "+canary.Name+" boundaries hook: "+boundaryErr.Error(), "", false)
+		}
+		doctorCheck(&r, label, canary.Name, ok, "")
+		return ok
+	}
+	for _, m := range canaries {
+		if !baseline(m, "baseline") {
+			return r
+		}
+	}
+	for i, name := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id"} {
+		m := canaries[i%2]
+		values := map[string]string{"name": m.Name, "prefix": m.IDPrefix, "package": m.Name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": m.Dir, "other_dir": canaries[(i+1)%2].Dir}
+		var files map[string]string
+		switch name {
+		case "undeclared":
+			files = maps.Undeclared
+		case "internal_eval":
+			files = maps.InternalEval
+		case "failing_eval":
+			files = maps.FailingEval
+		case "missing_id":
+			files = maps.MissingID
+		}
