diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b5a3bac4b4399805f074355a3e9ebf4ecae0caa5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func object(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func stringValue(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsValue(v any) []string { switch x:=v.(type) {case []string: return x; case []any: out:=[]string{}; for _,e:=range x { if s,ok:=e.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)} }; return out }; return nil }
+func hook(config map[string]any, key string) any { return object(config["hooks"])[key] }
+func moduleHook(fm map[string]any,key string) any { return object(fm["hooks"])[key] }
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\\''")+"'" }
+
+type command struct { shell string; argv []string; isShell bool }
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {
+ switch x:=v.(type) {
+ case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")}; return command{shell:x,isShell:true},nil
+ case []string: if len(x)==0 || x[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; return command{argv:append([]string(nil),x...)},nil
+ case []any: if len(x)==0 {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")}; a:=make([]string,len(x));for i,e:=range x {s,ok:=e.(string); if !ok {return command{},fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")};a[i]=s};if a[0]=="" {return command{},fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:a},nil
+ default: return command{},fmt.Errorf("missing hook command")
+ }
+}
+func expand(s string, values map[string]string, quote bool) string {
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} {if v,ok:=values[k];ok {if quote {v=shellQuote(v)}; pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)}}
+ return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+func (c command) expanded(values map[string]string) command {
+ if c.isShell {c.shell=expand(c.shell,values,true)} else {for i:=range c.argv {c.argv[i]=expand(c.argv[i],values,false)}};return c
+}
+func (c command) uses(key string) bool { p:="{"+key+"}";if c.isShell {return strings.Contains(c.shell,p)};for _,s:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(s,p){return true}};return false }
+func (c command) display() string {if c.isShell{return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type processResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) processResult {
+ if timeout>0 {var cancel context.CancelFunc;ctx,cancel=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()}
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.isShell {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,"sh","-c",c.shell)} else {cmd=exec.CommandContext(ctx,c.argv[0],c.argv[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir; cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err==nil {stop:=context.AfterFunc(ctx,func(){if cmd.Process!=nil { _=syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL) }});err=cmd.Wait();stop()}
+ r:=processResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}
+ if cmd.ProcessState!=nil {r.exit=cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode()}
+ if ctx.Err()!=nil {r.err=ctx.Err()}
+ return r
+}
+func inside(root,path string) string {if filepath.IsAbs(path){return path};return filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path))}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..06b11f5c0a07c78275fad094d60c463b47f8883f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor.go
@@ -0,0 +1,506 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+)
+
+const doctorPrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
+const doctorGuidance = "<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->\n"
+
+type canaryMap struct {
+	Version      int               `yaml:"version"`
+	Baseline     map[string]string `yaml:"baseline"`
+	Undeclared   map[string]string `yaml:"undeclared"`
+	InternalEval map[string]string `yaml:"internal_eval"`
+	FailingEval  map[string]string `yaml:"failing_eval"`
+	MissingID    map[string]string `yaml:"missing_id"`
+}
+
+func doctorDiag(r *model.DoctorReport, code, message, path string, warn bool) {
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Message: message, Path: path, Warning: warn})
+}
+func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport, name, module string, ok bool, detail string) {
+	r.Checks = append(r.Checks, model.DoctorCheck{Name: name, Module: module, Passed: ok, Detail: detail})
+}
+func hasErrors(ds []project.Diagnostic) bool {
+	for _, d := range ds {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func rendered(s string, values map[string]string) string {
+	pairs := []string{}
+	for _, key := range []string{"name", "prefix", "package", "go_module", "module_dir", "other_dir"} {
+		pairs = append(pairs, "{{"+key+"}}", values[key])
+	}
+	return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+func writeCanaryFile(root, dir, path, body string, values map[string]string) error {
+	if filepath.IsAbs(path) || strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Clean(path), "..") {
+		return fmt.Errorf("unsafe canary path %q", path)
+	}
+	full := filepath.Join(root, dir, strings.TrimSuffix(path, ".tmpl"))
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(full, []byte(rendered(body, values)), 0644)
+}
+func readCanaryInput(root string) (canaryMap, map[string]string, error) {
+	var maps canaryMap
+	raw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary canaries.yaml: %w", e)
+	}
+	if e = yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &maps); e != nil {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary canaries.yaml: %w", e)
+	}
+	if maps.Version != 1 {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary canaries.yaml: version 1 required")
+	}
+	if len(maps.Baseline) == 0 {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("canary baseline map missing")
+	}
+	templates := map[string]string{}
+	base := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/templates/module")
+	e = filepath.WalkDir(base, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		rel, e := filepath.Rel(base, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		data, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		templates[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = string(data)
+		return nil
+	})
+	if e != nil {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("module template: %w", e)
+	}
+	if _, ok := templates["SPEC.md"]; !ok {
+		return maps, nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md missing")
+	}
+	return maps, templates, nil
+}
+func doctorScratch(root string) (string, string, func(), error) {
+	repo, e := gitstore.Inspect(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	common := repo.CommonDir
+	if !filepath.IsAbs(common) {
+		common = filepath.Join(root, common)
+	}
+	common, e = filepath.EvalSymlinks(common)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	base := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees")
+	if e = os.MkdirAll(base, 0755); e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	scratch, e := os.MkdirTemp(base, "doctor-")
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	os.Remove(scratch)
+	if _, e = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "add", "--detach", scratch, "HEAD"); e != nil {
+		os.RemoveAll(scratch)
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	clean := func() {
+		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "remove", "--force", scratch)
+		_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch)
+		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "prune")
+	}
+	// Overlay the caller's current files, including modified and untracked inputs.
+	if e = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		rel, e := filepath.Rel(root, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if rel == ".git" || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".git"+string(filepath.Separator)) || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".fireweed/runs") {
+			if d.IsDir() {
+				return filepath.SkipDir
+			}
+			return nil
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		data, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		info, e := d.Info()
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		dest := filepath.Join(scratch, rel)
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dest), 0755); e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		return os.WriteFile(dest, data, info.Mode().Perm())
+	}); e != nil {
+		clean()
+		return "", "", nil, e
+	}
+	tracked,e:=gitOutput(root,"ls-files","-z")
+	if e==nil {for _,rel:=range strings.Split(tracked,"\x00") {if rel=="" {continue};if _,statErr:=os.Lstat(filepath.Join(root,rel));os.IsNotExist(statErr){_ =os.Remove(filepath.Join(scratch,rel))}}}
+	return scratch, common, clean, nil
+}
+func doctorWarnings(root string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
+	data, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "AGENTS.md"))
+	if e != nil || !strings.Contains(string(data), doctorGuidance) {
+		doctorDiag(r, "C16", "AGENTS.md managed guidance is missing or stale", "AGENTS.md", true)
+	}
+	base := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/playbooks")
+	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(base)
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		name := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md")
+		current, e := assets.Playbook(name)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(current))
+		raw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(base, entry.Name()))
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if e != nil || stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["embedded_base"]) != hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) {
+			doctorDiag(r, "C16", name+" playbook embedded_base is missing or stale", filepath.Join(".fireweed/playbooks", entry.Name()), true)
+		}
+	}
+}
+func Doctor(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest) model.DoctorReport {
+	r := model.DoctorReport{}
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Check(req.Root)...)
+	doctorWarnings(req.Root, &r)
+	if hasErrors(r.Diagnostics) {
+		return r
+	}
+	scratch, common, clean, e := doctorScratch(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "scratch worktree: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	defer clean()
+	snap, e := project.Load(scratch)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "scratch project: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	if h := hook(snap.Config, "setup"); h != nil {
+		c, e := parseCommand(h)
+		if e == nil {
+			p := runCommand(ctx, c, scratch, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": req.Bin}, req.Timeout)
+			e = p.err
+			if e == nil && p.exit != 0 {
+				e = fmt.Errorf("exit %d: %s", p.exit, p.stderr)
+			}
+		}
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "setup hook failed: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+			return r
+		}
+	}
+	maps, templates, e := readCanaryInput(scratch)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", e.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	goModule := ""
+	if data, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(scratch, "go.mod")); e == nil {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "module ") {
+				goModule = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "module "))
+				break
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	canaries := []project.Module{}
+	for i, name := range []string{"doctorcanarya", "doctorcanaryb"} {
+		prefix := []string{"DCA", "DCB"}[i]
+		dir := "packages/" + name
+		other := "packages/" + []string{"doctorcanaryb", "doctorcanarya"}[i]
+		values := map[string]string{"name": name, "prefix": prefix, "package": name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": dir, "other_dir": other}
+		for path, body := range templates {
+			if e = writeCanaryFile(scratch, dir, path, body, values); e != nil {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if e == nil {
+			for path, body := range maps.Baseline {
+				e = writeCanaryFile(scratch, dir, path, body, values)
+				if e != nil {
+					break
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "module template: "+e.Error(), pathJoin(dir, "SPEC.md"), false)
+			return r
+		}
+		specRaw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(scratch, dir, "SPEC.md"))
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "module template SPEC.md: "+e.Error(), dir+"/SPEC.md", false)
+			return r
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(specRaw))
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "module template SPEC.md: "+e.Error(), dir+"/SPEC.md", false)
+			return r
+		}
+		m := project.Module{Name: name, IDPrefix: prefix, Dir: dir, Document: doc}
+		if len(snap.Modules) > 0 {
+			m.Zones = snap.Modules[0].Zones
+		}
+		canaries = append(canaries, m)
+	}
+	// Make canaries visible to project loading and to FIREWEED_BIN modules --json.
+	configPath := filepath.Join(scratch, "fireweed.yaml")
+	raw, _ := os.ReadFile(configPath)
+	var config map[string]any
+	if yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &config) == nil {
+		modules := stringsValue(config["modules"])
+		for _, canary := range canaries {
+			if !matchAny(modules, canary.Dir) {
+				modules = append(modules, canary.Dir)
+			}
+		}
+		config["modules"] = modules
+		if output, e := yaml.Marshal(config); e == nil {
+			_ = os.WriteFile(configPath, output, 0644)
+		}
+	}
+	realModules := append([]project.Module(nil), snap.Modules...)
+	snap.Modules = append(snap.Modules, canaries...)
+	realSnapshot := snap
+	realSnapshot.Modules = realModules
+	boundaryDiags, boundaryErr := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: realSnapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+	for _, d := range boundaryDiags {
+		if d.Warning || d.Code == "X02" {
+			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
+		}
+	}
+	variants := []struct {
+		kind, label string
+		h           any
+	}{}
+	for _, kind := range []string{"eval", "boundaries"} {
+		if h := hook(snap.Config, kind); h != nil {
+			variants = append(variants, struct {
+				kind, label string
+				h           any
+			}{kind, "global " + kind + " hook", h})
+		}
+		for _, m := range snap.Modules[:len(snap.Modules)-2] {
+			if h := moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter, kind); h != nil {
+				variants = append(variants, struct {
+					kind, label string
+					h           any
+				}{kind, m.Name + " " + kind + " override", h})
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	hasEval := false
+	for _, v := range variants {
+		if v.kind == "eval" {
+			hasEval = true
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if !hasEval {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "baseline eval hook missing", "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	baseline := func(canary project.Module, label string) bool {
+		ok := true
+		for _, v := range variants {
+			if v.kind == "eval" {
+				if e := doctorEval(ctx, snap, canary, v.h, req); e != nil {
+					ok = false
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", label+" "+canary.Name+" "+v.label+": "+e.Error(), "", false)
+				}
+			} else {
+				lines, e := doctorBoundary(ctx, snap, v.h, req)
+				if e != nil || len(lines) > 0 {
+					ok = false
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", label+" "+canary.Name+" "+v.label+": "+fmt.Sprint(e, lines), "", false)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if boundaryErr != nil {
+			ok = false
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", label+" "+canary.Name+" boundaries hook: "+boundaryErr.Error(), "", false)
+		}
+		doctorCheck(&r, label, canary.Name, ok, "")
+		return ok
+	}
+	for _, m := range canaries {
+		if !baseline(m, "baseline") {
+			return r
+		}
+	}
+	for i, name := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id"} {
+		if i > 0 {
+			for _, baselineModule := range canaries {
+				if !baseline(baselineModule, "baseline") {
+					return r
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		m := canaries[i%2]
+		values := map[string]string{"name": m.Name, "prefix": m.IDPrefix, "package": m.Name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": m.Dir, "other_dir": canaries[(i+1)%2].Dir}
+		var files map[string]string
+		switch name {
+		case "undeclared":
+			files = maps.Undeclared
+		case "internal_eval":
+			files = maps.InternalEval
+		case "failing_eval":
+			files = maps.FailingEval
+		case "missing_id":
+			files = maps.MissingID
+		}
+		if len(files) == 0 {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", "canary "+name+" map missing", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", false)
+			continue
+		}
+		paths := []string{}
+		for p, b := range files {
+			if e = writeCanaryFile(scratch, m.Dir, p, b, values); e != nil {
+				doctorDiag(&r, "C14", name+" canary file: "+e.Error(), p, false)
+			}
+			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(scratch, m.Dir, strings.TrimSuffix(p, ".tmpl")))
+		}
+		for _, v := range variants {
+			if name == "undeclared" || name == "internal_eval" {
+				if v.kind != "boundaries" {
+					continue
+				}
+				lines, e := doctorBoundary(ctx, snap, v.h, req)
+				detected := false
+				for _, line := range lines {
+					if strings.HasPrefix(line, m.Name+":") && (name != "internal_eval" || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(line), "interface") || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(line), "internal")) {
+						detected = true
+					}
+				}
+				pass := e == nil && detected
+				doctorCheck(&r, name+" "+v.label, m.Name, pass, "")
+				if !pass {
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", name+" "+m.Name+" "+v.label+" missed canary", "", false)
+				}
+			} else {
+				if v.kind != "eval" {
+					continue
+				}
+				detected := doctorEvalCanary(ctx, snap, m, v.h, req, name)
+				doctorCheck(&r, name+" "+v.label, m.Name, detected, "")
+				if !detected {
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", name+" "+m.Name+" "+v.label+" missed canary", "", false)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		for _, p := range paths {
+			_ = os.Remove(p)
+		}
+		for _, recoveryModule := range canaries {
+			baseline(recoveryModule, "recovery "+name)
+		}
+	}
+	if !req.NoAgent {
+		doctorAgents(ctx, req, scratch, common, snap.Config, &r)
+	}
+	return r
+}
+func pathJoin(a, b string) string { return filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(a, b)) }
+func doctorEval(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, h any, req model.DoctorRequest) error {
+	fm := m.Document.Frontmatter
+	if fm == nil {
+		fm = map[string]any{}
+	}
+	copyFM := map[string]any{}
+	for k, v := range fm {
+		copyFM[k] = v
+	}
+	copyFM["hooks"] = map[string]any{"eval": h}
+	m.Document.Frontmatter = copyFM
+	snap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
+	rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	specs, e := moduleSpecs(m)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = RequireCoverage(rep, specs); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return RequirePass(rep, specs)
+}
+func doctorEvalCanary(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, h any, req model.DoctorRequest, name string) bool {
+	fm := map[string]any{}
+	for k, v := range m.Document.Frontmatter {
+		fm[k] = v
+	}
+	fm["hooks"] = map[string]any{"eval": h}
+	m.Document.Frontmatter = fm
+	snap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
+	rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+	if name == "failing_eval" {
+		return e == nil && rep.HookExit != 0 && RequireFailFirst(rep, []string{m.IDPrefix + "-001"}, nil) == nil
+	}
+	return e != nil && strings.Contains(e.Error(), "references unknown spec ID")
+}
+func doctorBoundary(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, h any, req model.DoctorRequest) ([]string, error) {
+	c, e := parseCommand(h)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	p := runCommand(ctx, c, snap.Root, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": req.Bin}, req.Timeout)
+	if p.err != nil {
+		var ex interface{ ExitCode() int }
+		if !errors.As(p.err, &ex) {
+			return nil, p.err
+		}
+	}
+	lines := []string{}
+	for _, s := range strings.Split(p.stdout+"\n"+p.stderr, "\n") {
+		s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
+		if s != "" {
+			lines = append(lines, s)
+		}
+	}
+	return lines, nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor_agents.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor_agents.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..0486cef80f020441d994c001cf8b491bc02b4471
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/doctor_agents.go
@@ -0,0 +1,114 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+)
+
+func tail20(s string) string {
+	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(s, "\n"), "\n")
+	if len(lines) > 20 {
+		lines = lines[len(lines)-20:]
+	}
+	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
+}
+func doctorAgents(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, scratch, common string, config map[string]any, r *model.DoctorReport) {
+	runRoot := filepath.Join(req.Root, ".fireweed", "runs")
+	_ = os.MkdirAll(runRoot, 0755)
+	runDir, e := os.MkdirTemp(runRoot, "doctor-")
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(r, "C15", "probe logs: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+		return
+	}
+	agent := object(config["agent"])
+	audit := object(config["audit"])
+	wrapperValue := agent["wrap"]
+	for _, role := range []string{"worker", "audit"} {
+		selected := agent["command"]
+		if role == "audit" {
+			selected = audit["command"]
+			if selected == nil {
+				selected = agent["command"]
+				doctorDiag(r, "C15", "audit shares worker command; shared-command blind spot", "", true)
+			}
+		}
+		c, e := parseCommand(selected)
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(r, "C15", role+" command: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+			doctorCheck(r, role, "", false, e.Error())
+			continue
+		}
+		var wrap command
+		if wrapperValue != nil {
+			wrap, e = parseCommand(wrapperValue)
+			if e != nil {
+				doctorDiag(r, "C15", role+" wrapper: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+				doctorCheck(r, role, "", false, e.Error())
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		promptFile := ""
+		if c.uses("prompt_file") || wrap.uses("prompt_file") {
+			f, e := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-doctor-prompt-*")
+			if e != nil {
+				doctorDiag(r, "C15", role+" prompt file: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+				continue
+			}
+			promptFile = f.Name()
+			_, _ = f.WriteString(doctorPrompt)
+			_ = f.Close()
+		}
+		values := map[string]string{"prompt": doctorPrompt, "prompt_file": promptFile, "git_common_dir": common}
+		c = c.expanded(values)
+		if wrapperValue != nil {
+			wrap = wrap.expanded(values)
+			if wrap.isShell {
+				if c.isShell {
+					wrap.shell += " sh -c " + shellQuote(c.shell)
+				} else {
+					for _, arg := range c.argv {
+						wrap.shell += " " + shellQuote(arg)
+					}
+				}
+			} else {
+				if c.isShell {
+					wrap.argv = append(wrap.argv, "sh", "-c", c.shell)
+				} else {
+					wrap.argv = append(wrap.argv, c.argv...)
+				}
+			}
+			c = wrap
+		}
+		timeout := req.Timeout
+		if timeout <= 0 {
+			timeout = 3 * time.Minute
+		}
+		p := runCommand(ctx, c, scratch, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": req.Bin}, timeout)
+		if promptFile != "" {
+			_ = os.Remove(promptFile)
+		}
+		path := filepath.Join(runDir, "doctor-"+role+"-1.log")
+		_ = os.WriteFile(path, []byte(p.stdout+p.stderr), 0644)
+		detail := "log: " + path
+		replied := strings.Contains(p.stdout, "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
+		success := p.err == nil && p.exit == 0 && replied
+		doctorCheck(r, role, "", success, detail)
+		if !success {
+			tail := tail20(p.stdout + "\n" + p.stderr)
+			kind := "command failure"
+			for _, pattern := range stringsValue(config["limit_patterns"]) {
+				if pattern != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(tail), strings.ToLower(pattern)) {
+					kind = "usage limit"
+					break
+				}
+			}
+			doctorDiag(r, "C15", fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s: %v exit %d\n%s", role, kind, c.display(), p.err, p.exit, tail), path, false)
+		}
+	}
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/history.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/history.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..af94e1100aca339253866b3d1ca7ae32adcc7a6f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/history.go
@@ -0,0 +1,271 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func gitOutput(root string, args ...string) (string, error) {
+	c := exec.Command("git", append([]string{"-C", root}, args...)...)
+	b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), e, b)
+	}
+	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
+}
+func gitPaths(root, rev string) ([]string, error) {
+	s, e := gitOutput(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", rev)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	if s == "" {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	return strings.Split(s, "\n"), nil
+}
+func changeStates(root, rev string) (map[string]struct{ path, phase, module string }, error) {
+	out := map[string]struct{ path, phase, module string }{}
+	if rev == "" {
+		return out, nil
+	}
+	paths, e := gitPaths(root, rev)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	for _, p := range paths {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(p, "changes/") || !strings.HasSuffix(p, ".md") || len(filepath.Base(p))<6 || filepath.Base(p)[4]!='-' {
+			continue
+		}
+		raw, e := gitOutput(root, "show", rev+":"+p)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		out[filepath.Base(p)] = struct{ path, phase, module string }{p, stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]), stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["module"])}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+type fileDelta struct{ status, path, old string }
+
+func deltas(root, parent, child string, merge bool) ([]fileDelta, error) {
+	var args []string
+	if merge {
+		args = []string{"diff-tree", "--cc", "--name-only", "-r", child}
+	} else {
+		args = []string{"diff", "--name-status", "-M", parent, child}
+	}
+	raw, e := gitOutput(root, args...)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []fileDelta{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(raw, "\n") {
+		if line == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if merge {
+			if len(line) == 40 && line == child {
+				continue
+			}
+			out = append(out, fileDelta{status: "M", path: line})
+			continue
+		}
+		f := strings.Split(line, "\t")
+		if len(f) < 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		d := fileDelta{status: f[0], path: f[1]}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(d.status, "R") && len(f) >= 3 {
+			d.old = f[1]
+			d.path = f[2]
+		}
+		out = append(out, d)
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func findModule(s project.Snapshot, path string) *project.Module {
+	for i := range s.Modules {
+		if pathUnder(path, s.Modules[i].Dir) {
+			return &s.Modules[i]
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func zoneIn(s project.Snapshot, path string, kind string) bool {
+	m := findModule(s, path)
+	if m == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	rel := strings.TrimPrefix(path, m.Dir+"/")
+	got := contracts.ResolveZone(rel, m.Zones)
+	return got == kind || (kind == "append_only" && got == "append-only")
+}
+func History(root, revisionRange string) (model.HistoryReport, error) {
+	result := model.HistoryReport{Commits: []string{}}
+	if revisionRange == "" {
+		snap, e := project.Load(root)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		base := stringValue(snap.Config["base"])
+		if base == "" {
+			return result, fmt.Errorf("missing configured base")
+		}
+		resolved, e := gitOutput(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", base)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		merge, e := gitOutput(root, "merge-base", "HEAD", resolved)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		revisionRange = merge + "..HEAD"
+	}
+	raw, e := gitOutput(root, "rev-list", "--topo-order", "--reverse", revisionRange)
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	if raw == "" {
+		return result, nil
+	}
+	result.Commits = strings.Split(raw, "\n")
+	for _, oid := range result.Commits {
+		parentLine, e := gitOutput(root, "rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		fields := strings.Fields(parentLine)
+		parents := fields[1:]
+		before := ""
+		if len(parents) > 0 {
+			before = parents[0]
+		}
+		afterSnap, e := project.LoadAt(root, oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		var beforeSnap project.Snapshot
+		if before != "" {
+			beforeSnap, e = project.LoadAt(root, before)
+			if e != nil {
+				return result, e
+			}
+		}
+		afterChanges, e := changeStates(root, oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		parentStates := []map[string]struct{ path, phase, module string }{}
+		for _, p := range parents {
+			states, e := changeStates(root, p)
+			if e != nil {
+				return result, e
+			}
+			parentStates = append(parentStates, states)
+		}
+		worker := false
+		applied := false
+		squashed := false
+		workerModule := ""
+		projected := afterSnap
+		for name, state := range afterChanges {
+			newPhase := true
+			hadImpl := false
+			for _, p := range parentStates {
+				if previous, ok := p[name]; ok {
+					if previous.phase == state.phase {
+						newPhase = false
+					}
+					if previous.phase == "impl" {
+						hadImpl = true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+			if !newPhase {
+				continue
+			}
+			if state.phase == "audit" || state.phase == "evals" || state.phase == "impl" || state.phase == "applied" {
+				worker = true
+				workerModule = state.module
+			}
+			if state.phase == "applied" {
+				applied = hadImpl
+				if raw, e := gitOutput(root, "show", oid+":"+state.path); e == nil {
+					if doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw); e == nil {
+						set := object(doc.Frontmatter["set"])
+						for j := range projected.Modules {
+							if projected.Modules[j].Name == state.module {
+								m := &projected.Modules[j]
+								if v, ok := set["interface"]; ok {
+									m.Zones.Interface = stringsValue(v)
+								}
+								if v, ok := set["evals"]; ok {
+									m.Zones.Evals = stringsValue(v)
+								}
+								if v, ok := set["append_only"]; ok {
+									m.Zones.AppendOnly = stringsValue(v)
+								}
+							}
+						}
+					}
+				}
+				if !hadImpl {
+					squashed = true
+					result.Squashed = append(result.Squashed, model.SquashedChange{Commit: oid, Change: state.path})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		ds, e := deltas(root, before, oid, len(parents) > 1)
+		if e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		seen := map[string]bool{}
+		add := func(code, path string) {
+			key := code + "|" + path
+			if seen[key] {
+				return
+			}
+			seen[key] = true
+			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Path: path, Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s in commit %s", code, oid)})
+		}
+		for _, d := range ds {
+			paths := []string{d.path}
+			if d.old != "" {
+				paths = append(paths, d.old)
+			}
+			for _, path := range paths {
+				if path == "" {
+					continue
+				}
+				if worker && !squashed {
+					if strings.HasPrefix(path, ".fireweed/playbooks/") || matchAny(stringsValue(beforeSnap.Config["protected"]), path) || matchAny(stringsValue(afterSnap.Config["protected"]), path) {
+						add("H01", path)
+					}
+					if applied {
+						m := findModule(projected, path)
+						if m != nil && m.Name == workerModule && (zoneIn(beforeSnap, path, "evals") || zoneIn(beforeSnap, path, "interface") || zoneIn(projected, path, "evals") || zoneIn(projected, path, "interface")) {
+							add("H02", path)
+						}
+					}
+				}
+				if (zoneIn(beforeSnap, path, "append_only") || zoneIn(afterSnap, path, "append_only")) && existsAt(root, before, path) {
+					add("H03", path)
+				}
+				if strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") && d.status != "D" && path == d.path && existsAt(root, before, path) {
+					add("H04", path)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return result, nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module)([]contracts.Item,error){body,ok:=contracts.Section(m.Document.Body,"Specs");if !ok{return nil,nil};items,err:=contracts.ParseItems(body);if err!=nil {msg:=err.Error();if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(msg),"duplicate") {return nil,coded("C05","%s",msg)};return nil,coded("C03","%s",msg)};return items,nil}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, req model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+ var m *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module {m=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}};if m==nil{return model.Report{},coded("U02","unknown module %q",req.Module)}
+ specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*m);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+ h:=moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter,"eval");if h==nil {h=hook(req.Snapshot.Config,"eval")};if h==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",m.Name)}
+ c,err:=parseCommand(h);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","%v",err)}
+ f,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};reportPath:=f.Name();f.Close();os.Remove(reportPath);defer os.Remove(reportPath)
+ values:=map[string]string{"module":m.Name,"module_dir":m.Dir,"report":reportPath};c=c.expanded(values)
+ r:=runCommand(ctx,c,req.Snapshot.Root,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":req.Bin},req.Timeout)
+ report:=model.Report{HookExit:r.exit,Stdout:r.stdout,Stderr:r.stderr}
+ if r.err!=nil {var exit *os.PathError;var ex interface{ ExitCode() int };if errors.As(r.err,&exit)||!errors.As(r.err,&ex){return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",r.err)}}
+ data,err:=os.ReadFile(reportPath);if err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","read JUnit report: %v",err)}
+ parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+ failed:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"{failed=true;break}}
+ if (r.exit==0)==failed {return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",r.exit)}
+ return report,nil
+}
+
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context,req model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+ snap:=req.Snapshot;diags:=[]project.Diagnostic{};var causes []error
+ baseline:=map[string]bool{};if data,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root,".fireweed","boundaries-baseline"));e==nil {for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(data),"\n") {if line!="" {baseline[line]=true}}}
+ global:=hook(snap.Config,"boundaries")
+ run:=func(label string,h any){c,e:=parseCommand(h);if e!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:label+": "+e.Error()});causes=append(causes,e);return};r:=runCommand(ctx,c.expanded(map[string]string{}),snap.Root,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":req.Bin},req.Timeout);if r.err!=nil {var ex interface{ExitCode()int};if !errors.As(r.err,&ex)||ctx.Err()!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:label+": "+r.err.Error()});causes=append(causes,r.err);return}}
+  for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr,"\n"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line==""||baseline[line] {continue};suppressed:=false;for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);if reason!=""&&strings.HasPrefix(line,m.Name+":") {suppressed=true;break}};if suppressed{continue};diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X01",Message:line});causes=append(causes,fmt.Errorf("%s",line))}
+ }
+ if global!=nil {run("global boundaries hook",global)}
+ for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);if reason!="" {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X03",Message:m.Name+": boundaries opt out: "+reason,Warning:true})}
+  override:=moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter,"boundaries");if override!=nil {run(m.Name+" boundaries hook",override)} else if global==nil {if len(m.Zones.Disposable)>0&&reason=="" {msg:=m.Name+": missing boundaries hook";diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:msg});causes=append(causes,errors.New(msg))} else {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X04",Message:m.Name+": no boundary enforcement required",Warning:true})}}
+ }
+ return diags,errors.Join(causes...)
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..5f34dd4aedaf1e545548732915909ed46304979c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go
@@ -0,0 +1,175 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"encoding/xml"
+	"io"
+	"regexp"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitCase struct {
+	Name      string         `xml:"name,attr"`
+	Classname string         `xml:"classname,attr"`
+	Time      string         `xml:"time,attr"`
+	Failure   []junitProblem `xml:"failure"`
+	Error     []junitProblem `xml:"error"`
+	Skipped   []struct{}     `xml:"skipped"`
+}
+type junitProblem struct {
+	Message string `xml:"message,attr"`
+	Body    string `xml:",chardata"`
+}
+
+var specToken = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(^|[^a-z0-9])([a-z]+[-_]?[0-9]{3,})([^0-9]|$)`)
+
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte, specs []contracts.Item) (model.Report, error) {
+	dec := xml.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)))
+	var start xml.StartElement
+	var ok bool
+	for { root,err:=dec.Token();if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)};if start,ok=root.(xml.StartElement);ok{break};switch v:=root.(type){case xml.CharData:if strings.TrimSpace(string(v))!="" {return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q","")};case xml.Comment,xml.ProcInst,xml.Directive:default:return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q","")}}
+	if !ok || (start.Name.Local != "testsuite" && start.Name.Local != "testsuites") {
+		name := ""
+		if ok {
+			name = start.Name.Local
+		}
+		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "invalid JUnit root %q", name)
+	}
+	report := model.Report{Cases: []model.Case{}}
+	depth := 1
+	for depth > 0 {
+		tok, e := dec.Token()
+		if e != nil {
+			if e == io.EOF {
+				return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: unexpected EOF")
+			}
+			return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", e)
+		}
+		switch v := tok.(type) {
+		case xml.StartElement:
+			depth++
+			if v.Name.Local != "testcase" {
+				continue
+			}
+			var raw junitCase
+			if e := dec.DecodeElement(&raw, &v); e != nil {
+				return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", e)
+			}
+			depth--
+			c := model.Case{Name: raw.Name, Classname: raw.Classname, Result: "pass"}
+			if raw.Time != "" {
+				c.Seconds, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(raw.Time, 64)
+			}
+			if len(raw.Skipped) > 0 {
+				c.Result = "skip"
+			}
+			if len(raw.Failure) > 0 || len(raw.Error) > 0 {
+				c.Result = "fail"
+				parts := []string{}
+				for _, p := range append(raw.Failure, raw.Error...) {
+					if s := strings.TrimSpace(p.Message); s != "" {
+						parts = append(parts, s)
+					}
+					if s := strings.TrimSpace(p.Body); s != "" {
+						parts = append(parts, s)
+					}
+				}
+				c.Failure = strings.Join(parts, "\n")
+			}
+			for _, s := range specs {
+				if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID, c.Name, c.Classname) {
+					c.IDs = append(c.IDs, s.ID)
+				}
+			}
+			if len(c.IDs) == 0 {
+				for _, candidate := range []string{c.Name, c.Classname} {
+					for _, m := range specToken.FindAllStringSubmatch(candidate, -1) {
+						if strings.ContainsAny(m[2], "-_") {
+							return report, coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, m[2])
+						}
+						id := strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(m[2], "_", "-"))
+						for _, s := range specs {
+							prefix := strings.SplitN(strings.ToUpper(s.ID), "-", 2)[0]
+							if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ReplaceAll(id, "-", ""), prefix) {
+								return report, coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, m[2])
+							}
+						}
+					}
+				}
+				return report, coded("C11", "testcase %q has no known spec ID", c.Name)
+			}
+			report.Seconds += c.Seconds
+			report.Cases = append(report.Cases, c)
+		case xml.EndElement:
+			depth--
+		}
+	}
+	for {tok,e:=dec.Token();if e==io.EOF{break};if e!=nil{return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",e)};switch v:=tok.(type){case xml.CharData:if strings.TrimSpace(string(v))==""{continue};case xml.Comment,xml.ProcInst:continue};return report,coded("C11","parse JUnit: trailing XML")}
+	return report, nil
+}
+func hasID(ids []string, id string) bool {
+	for _, x := range ids {
+		if x == id {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func exemptTag(tag string) bool {
+	s := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
+	return strings.HasPrefix(s, "review") || strings.HasPrefix(s, "quarantine")
+}
+func RequireCoverage(report model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
+	for _, s := range specs {
+		if exemptTag(s.Tag) {
+			continue
+		}
+		found := false
+		for _, c := range report.Cases {
+			if c.Result != "skip" && hasID(c.IDs, s.ID) {
+				found = true
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if !found {
+			return coded("C10", "no coverage for %s", s.ID)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func RequireFailFirst(report model.Report, ids, already []string) error {
+	for _, id := range ids {
+		if hasID(already, id) {
+			continue
+		}
+		ok := false
+		for _, c := range report.Cases {
+			if c.Result == "fail" && hasID(c.IDs, id) {
+				ok = true
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if !ok {
+			return coded("P2-01", "no fail-first case for %s", id)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func RequirePass(report model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
+	for _, c := range report.Cases {
+		if c.Result != "fail" {
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, id := range c.IDs {
+			for _, s := range specs {
+				if s.ID == id && !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(s.Tag), "quarantine") {
+					return coded("E01", "failed case %q for %s", c.Name, id)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..84c024ea5e0bc2b4d832580df6b2970458573006
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func pathUnder(path, dir string) bool {
+	path = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path))
+	dir = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(dir)), "/")
+	return strings.HasPrefix(path, dir+"/")
+}
+func matchAny(globs []string, path string) bool {
+	for _, g := range globs {
+		if contracts.MatchGlob(g, path) {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func existsAt(root, rev, path string) bool {
+	if rev == "" {
+		return false
+	}
+	_, err := gitstore.ReadAt(root, rev, path)
+	return err == nil
+}
+func Zones(req model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {
+	var target *project.Module
+	for i := range req.Snapshot.Modules {
+		if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name == req.Module {
+			target = &req.Snapshot.Modules[i]
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	bad := []project.Diagnostic{}
+	reject := func(path, reason string) {
+		bad = append(bad, project.Diagnostic{Code: "Z01", Path: path, Message: reason})
+	}
+	check := func(path string, src, rename bool) {
+		if path == "" {
+			return
+		}
+		path = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path))
+		if pathUnder(path, ".fireweed") || matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]), path) {
+			reject(path, "protected path")
+			return
+		}
+		if path == req.ChangePath { return }
+		if pathUnder(path, "changes") { reject(path, "other change file"); return }
+		for _, m := range req.Snapshot.Modules {
+			if path == m.Dir+"/SPEC.md" {
+				reject(path, "module SPEC.md")
+				return
+			}
+			if pathUnder(path, m.Dir) && m.Name != req.Module {
+				reject(path, "another module")
+				return
+			}
+		}
+		if req.Phase == "audit" {
+			reject(path, "audit permits only current change")
+			return
+		}
+		if target != nil && pathUnder(path, target.Dir) {
+			rel := strings.TrimPrefix(path, strings.TrimSuffix(target.Dir, "/")+"/")
+			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(rel, target.Zones)
+			switch zone {
+			case "protected":
+				reject(path, "protected zone")
+			case "evals":
+				if req.Phase != "evals" {
+					reject(path, "evals zone")
+				}
+			case "interface":
+				if req.Phase != "evals" || !req.InterfaceDeclared {
+					reject(path, "interface zone")
+				}
+			case "append_only", "append-only":
+				if req.Phase != "impl" || src || rename || existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root, req.Base, path) {
+					reject(path, "append_only zone")
+				}
+			case "disposable":
+				if req.Phase == "evals" && (src || existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root, req.Base, path)) {
+					reject(path, "existing disposable file")
+				}
+			case "preserve":
+				if req.Phase == "evals" {
+					reject(path, "preserve zone")
+				}
+			}
+			return
+		}
+		if !matchAny(stringsValue(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]), path) {
+			reject(path, "outside worker_writable")
+		}
+	}
+	for _, c := range req.Changes {
+		if c.OldPath != "" {
+			check(c.OldPath, true, true)
+		}
+		check(c.Path, false, c.OldPath != "")
+	}
+	return bad
+}

# Rebuild checks

Target spec and Decisions:
---
depends_on:
    - contracts
    - gitstore
    - assets
    - project
id_prefix: CHK
interface:
    - api.go
    - model/**
name: checks
---

# checks

## Specs

### CHK-001
ParseJUnit MUST accept testsuite or testsuites documents, including nested suites, returning testcase name, classname and time.

### CHK-002
RequireCoverage MUST cover each current spec except review or quarantine with a non-skipped referencing case. Missing coverage MUST return a C10-prefixed error.

### CHK-003
Evaluate MUST run the configured eval hook, accepting shell strings or argv.

### CHK-004
During audit, Zones MUST allow edits only to the current change file.

### CHK-005
Boundaries MUST run applicable global and per-module boundary hooks.

### CHK-006
Zones MUST reject edits to protected paths in every phase.

### CHK-007
Zones MUST reject edits to module SPEC.md files in every phase.

### CHK-008
Zones MUST reject edits within another module in every phase.

### CHK-009
Zones MUST reject edits to change files other than the current change in every phase.

### CHK-010
During evals and impl, Zones MUST allow edits outside modules only when the path matches worker_writable, except for the current change file.

### CHK-011
During evals, Zones MUST allow edits in the target module's evals zone.

### CHK-012
During evals, Zones MUST allow edits in the target module's interface zone only when InterfaceDeclared is true.

### CHK-013
During evals, Zones MUST allow edits in the target module's disposable zone only for files absent from the phase base.

### CHK-014
During evals, Zones MUST allow edits in the target module's other zone.

### CHK-015
During evals, Zones MUST reject edits in the target module's preserve zone.

### CHK-016
During impl, Zones MUST reject edits in the target module's evals zone.

### CHK-017
During impl, Zones MUST reject edits in the target module's interface zone.

### CHK-018
During impl, Zones MUST allow edits in the target module's disposable zone.

### CHK-019
During impl, Zones MUST allow edits in the target module's preserve zone.

### CHK-020
During impl, Zones MUST allow edits in the target module's other zone.

### CHK-021
During evals and impl, Zones MUST allow edits to the current change file.

### CHK-022
During impl, Zones MUST allow only newly added files in the target module's append_only zone.

### CHK-023
During evals, Zones MUST reject edits in the target module's append_only zone.

### CHK-024
Zones MUST check both the source and destination of a rename against phase permissions.

### CHK-025
RequireFailFirst MUST find a failed or errored referencing case for every requested enforced ID except already_satisfied; passing, skipped, empty or unrelated failures do not qualify. Missing genuine fail-first evidence MUST return a P2-01-prefixed error.

### CHK-026
RequirePass MUST reject failed or errored cases referencing any non-quarantined spec with an E01-prefixed error.

### CHK-027
ParseJUnit MUST reject malformed XML with a C11-prefixed error.

### CHK-028
ParseJUnit MUST reject testcases with missing or unknown spec IDs with a C11-prefixed error.

### CHK-029
ParseJUnit MUST map testcase name and classname to current spec IDs using contracts.MatchesID.

### CHK-030
ParseJUnit MUST classify failure and error elements as fail, and skipped elements as skip.

### CHK-031
Evaluate MUST prefer a module's eval hook override over the global eval hook.

### CHK-032
Evaluate MUST expand module, module_dir and report placeholders once in shell strings or argv, quoting substituted shell values.

### CHK-033
Evaluate MUST set the hook's FIREWEED_BIN environment variable to the request Bin.

### CHK-034
Evaluate MUST retain the hook process's stdout, stderr and exit code in its returned report.

### CHK-035
Evaluate MUST parse the hook's written JUnit report into the returned report's cases.

### CHK-036
Evaluate MUST fail with a C11-prefixed error when the eval hook cannot launch or exceeds its timeout.

### CHK-037
Evaluate MUST fail with a C11-prefixed error when the eval hook does not write its JUnit report.

### CHK-038
Evaluate MUST reject a zero exit with mapped failures or a nonzero exit without mapped failures with a C11-prefixed error, while accepting a nonzero exit with mapped failures as valid report evidence.

### CHK-039
Boundaries MUST return errors with diagnostic X01 for unsuppressed module-attributed violations.

### CHK-040
Boundaries MUST return a visible X03 warning containing the reason for a reasoned boundaries_opt_out.

### CHK-041
Boundaries MUST suppress only exact baseline lines from normally exited hooks.

### CHK-042
Boundaries MUST suppress only the opted-out module's violation lines through a reasoned opt-out after a hook exits normally.

### CHK-043
Boundaries MUST report hook launch, cancellation or timeout failures as errors with a diagnostic whose Code is X02. The returned error MUST preserve the hook failure cause without a leading X02 prefix.

### CHK-044
Boundaries MUST fail with diagnostic X02 for a missing hook required by a module with disposable globs and no reasoned opt-out.

### CHK-045
Boundaries MUST warn with diagnostic X04 without an error for a missing hook when no boundary enforcement is required.

### CHK-046
Evaluate MUST return C11-prefixed errors for existing eval-hook setup failures, including missing or invalid hook commands.

### CHK-047
Evaluate MUST return a U02-prefixed error for an unknown requested module.

### CHK-048
Evaluate MUST return C03-prefixed errors for malformed module item syntax and C05-prefixed errors for duplicate module item identities.

### CHK-049
Doctor MUST retain project.Check diagnostics and prevent hook or agent probes when the current project has a static error.

### CHK-050
Doctor MUST run probes using current project files in a detached scratch worktree below the common Git directory's fireweed/worktrees, leaving the caller's checkout unchanged.

### CHK-051
Doctor MUST remove its scratch worktree and Git registration after successful or failed probes.

### CHK-052
Doctor MUST run the configured setup hook in scratch before probes; a setup failure MUST produce C14 naming the setup hook and prevent later probes.

### CHK-053
Doctor MUST render two uniquely named throwaway modules from project-owned module templates and the version-1 canary baseline, substituting name, prefix, package, go_module, module_dir and other_dir.

### CHK-054
Doctor MUST report C14 naming missing or malformed module templates or required canary maps and skip the affected probes.

### CHK-055
Doctor MUST require passing baseline evals and coverage for the throwaway canary modules, and applicable boundaries, before planting canaries and after removing each planted canary. This baseline coverage requirement applies to the canary modules used to prove hooks, rather than every existing module. Recovery failures MUST produce C14 naming the failed hook and canary.

### CHK-056
Doctor MUST plant the supplied undeclared canary and require its boundary hook to report a module-attributed violation; a missed canary MUST produce C14 naming the hook and canary.

### CHK-057
Doctor MUST plant the supplied internal_eval canary and require its boundary hook to report a module-attributed interface violation; a missed canary MUST produce C14 naming the hook and canary.

### CHK-058
Doctor MUST require the supplied failing_eval canary to produce a failed referencing testcase and nonzero eval exit; compile errors, missing reports and unrelated failures MUST NOT count as detection.

### CHK-059
Doctor MUST require the supplied missing_id canary to be rejected for its unmapped testcase ID; unrelated hook or report failures MUST NOT count as detection.

### CHK-060
Doctor MUST test applicable global eval and boundary hooks and every per-module override through their corresponding canary probes.

### CHK-061
Doctor MUST set probe hooks' FIREWEED_BIN to the request Bin and make the scratch canary modules discoverable through that executable's modules output.

### CHK-062
Doctor MUST retain each real module's reasoned X03 boundaries-opt-out warning and applicable X04 warning when no boundary enforcement is required.

### CHK-063
Doctor MUST run the worker and audit commands once each in scratch through the configured agent.wrap with a fixed-reply prompt, requiring exit 0 and the requested reply for success.

### CHK-064
Doctor MUST use agent.command for the audit probe when audit.command is unset and emit a C15 warning identifying the shared-command blind spot.

### CHK-065
Doctor MUST bound each agent probe by the request Timeout or three minutes when unset, and report C15 failures with the command and its final 20 output lines.

### CHK-066
Doctor MUST classify a configured limit_patterns match in an agent probe's final 20 output lines as a C15 usage-limit diagnostic rather than an ordinary command failure.

### CHK-067
Doctor with NoAgent MUST skip worker and audit command execution while retaining hook canary and recovery checks.

### CHK-068
Doctor MUST emit a C16 warning when the AGENTS.md managed block is missing or differs from the current fireweed guidance, while accepting a current block regardless of surrounding text.

### CHK-069
Doctor MUST emit a C16 warning when a project playbook override's embedded_base is missing or differs from the SHA-256 of its current embedded playbook; a matching base MUST avoid that warning.

### CHK-070
History MUST list full commit IDs selected by the supplied Git revision range in oldest-first topological order.
For an empty range it MUST use the merge base of HEAD and the locally resolved configured base through HEAD.

### CHK-071
History MUST identify worker commits from new phase assignments in change-file contents across pending/archive moves, rather than commit subjects.
Deleting a change document without assigning a phase MUST not by itself classify the commit as a worker commit.

### CHK-072
History MUST report H01 when a worker commit changes a protected path or a project playbook override.

### CHK-073
History MUST report H02 when an impl-to-applied phase commit changes evals or interface zones.

### CHK-074
History MUST report H03 when any commit modifies, deletes or renames an existing append_only path, including merge-resolution changes identified by combined Git diffs.

### CHK-075
History MUST report H04 when a commit modifies an existing file under changes/archive.
Deleting an archived change file MUST remain allowed by H04.

### CHK-076
History MUST recognize each new applied phase whose parents lack an impl phase as squashed, listing its commit and change without a warning.
H01 and H02 MUST not apply to those squashed commits.
H03 and H04 MUST still apply.

### CHK-077
History MUST return each rule finding as a Diagnostic with its H01–H04 code, repository-relative Path and full commit ID in Message, using the recorded before/after zone maps and the worker change's projected set values.

### CHK-078
History MUST return an error when a revision range or required recorded project/change document cannot be read or parsed.

### CHK-079
ParseJUnit MUST retain the message attributes and text bodies of JUnit failure and error elements in each affected Case.Failure, including message-only and body-only diagnostics.
A testcase without such text MUST have an empty Failure.

### CHK-080
Evaluate MUST retain parsed Case.Failure strings in its returned Report.Cases, including when failing testcases make the eval hook exit nonzero.

### CHK-081
Doctor MUST persist complete stdout and stderr from every executed worker and audit probe, including failed, timed-out and cancelled probes, under the invoking project's .fireweed/runs/<run>/<phase>-1.log. Each Doctor invocation MUST use a fresh shared run identity, with phases doctor-worker and doctor-audit. Each executed probe's Detail MUST identify its log file by absolute path.

### CHK-082
Doctor MUST expand {prompt}, {prompt_file} and {git_common_dir} once in selected worker/audit command templates and wrapper argv, quoting shell substitutions and preserving argv values literally.

### CHK-083
Doctor MUST create one temporary file containing the exact probe prompt only when a selected command or wrapper template uses {prompt_file}, and expand that placeholder to its absolute path. The file MUST remain available through execution and be removed afterward, including after launch failure, nonzero exit, timeout or cancellation.

## Decisions

[0071-doctor-probes] Doctor requests the literal reply FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK; limit_patterns match
case-insensitive literal substrings. Project playbook overrides use frontmatter
embedded_base containing the hexadecimal SHA-256 of the embedded playbook text.

[0114-history-validation] A merge merely retaining a phase value already held by a parent is not a new
phase assignment; combined merge diffs still enforce append-only files.
Squashed entries identify the change's repository-relative after-path; ordinary
non-merge phase transitions compare the sole parent.

package engine

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
)

func moduleSpecs(m project.Module) ([]contracts.Item, error) {
	body, ok := contracts.Section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil
	}
	items, err := contracts.ParseItems(body)
	if err != nil {
		msg := err.Error()
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(msg), "duplicate") {
			return nil, coded("C05", "%s", msg)
		}
		return nil, coded("C03", "%s", msg)
	}
	return items, nil
}
func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, req model.HookRequest) (model.Report, error) {
	var m *project.Module
	for i := range req.Snapshot.Modules {
		if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name == req.Module {
			m = &req.Snapshot.Modules[i]
			break
		}
	}
	if m == nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("U02", "unknown module %q", req.Module)
	}
	specs, err := moduleSpecs(*m)
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, err
	}
	h := moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter, "eval")
	if h == nil {
		h = hook(req.Snapshot.Config, "eval")
	}
	if h == nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "missing eval hook for %s", m.Name)
	}
	c, err := parseCommand(h)
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "%v", err)
	}
	f, err := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-junit-*.xml")
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "create JUnit report: %v", err)
	}
	reportPath := f.Name()
	f.Close()
	os.Remove(reportPath)
	defer os.Remove(reportPath)
	values := map[string]string{"module": m.Name, "module_dir": m.Dir, "report": reportPath}
	c = c.expanded(values)
	r := runCommand(ctx, c, req.Snapshot.Root, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": req.Bin}, req.Timeout)
	report := model.Report{HookExit: r.exit, Stdout: r.stdout, Stderr: r.stderr}
	if r.err != nil {
		var exit *os.PathError
		var ex interface{ ExitCode() int }
		if errors.As(r.err, &exit) || !errors.As(r.err, &ex) {
			return report, coded("C11", "run hook: %v", r.err)
		}
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(reportPath)
	if err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "read JUnit report: %v", err)
	}
	parsed, err := ParseJUnit(data, specs)
	if err != nil {
		return report, err
	}
	report.Cases = parsed.Cases
	report.Seconds = parsed.Seconds
	failed := false
	for _, c := range report.Cases {
		if c.Result == "fail" {
			failed = true
			break
		}
	}
	if (r.exit == 0) == failed {
		return report, coded("C11", "eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures", r.exit)
	}
	return report, nil
}

func Boundaries(ctx context.Context, req model.BoundaryRequest) ([]project.Diagnostic, error) {
	snap := req.Snapshot
	diags := []project.Diagnostic{}
	var causes []error
	baseline := map[string]bool{}
	if data, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root, ".fireweed", "boundaries-baseline")); e == nil {
		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
			if line != "" {
				baseline[line] = true
			}
		}
	}
	global := hook(snap.Config, "boundaries")
	run := func(label string, h any) {
		c, e := parseCommand(h)
		if e != nil {
			diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X02", Message: label + ": " + e.Error()})
			causes = append(causes, e)
			return
		}
		r := runCommand(ctx, c.expanded(map[string]string{}), snap.Root, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": req.Bin}, req.Timeout)
		if r.err != nil {
			var ex interface{ ExitCode() int }
			if !errors.As(r.err, &ex) || ctx.Err() != nil {
				diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X02", Message: label + ": " + r.err.Error()})
				causes = append(causes, r.err)
				return
			}
		}
		for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr, "\n"), "\n") {
			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
			if line == "" || baseline[line] {
				continue
			}
			suppressed := false
			for _, m := range snap.Modules {
				reason := stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"])
				if reason != "" && strings.HasPrefix(line, m.Name+":") {
					suppressed = true
					break
				}
			}
			if suppressed {
				continue
			}
			diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X01", Message: line})
			causes = append(causes, fmt.Errorf("%s", line))
		}
	}
	if global != nil {
		run("global boundaries hook", global)
	}
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		reason := stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"])
		if reason != "" {
			diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X03", Message: m.Name + ": boundaries opt out: " + reason, Warning: true})
		}
		override := moduleHook(m.Document.Frontmatter, "boundaries")
		if override != nil {
			run(m.Name+" boundaries hook", override)
		} else if global == nil {
			if len(m.Zones.Disposable) > 0 && reason == "" {
				msg := m.Name + ": missing boundaries hook"
				diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X02", Message: msg})
				causes = append(causes, errors.New(msg))
			} else {
				diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X04", Message: m.Name + ": no boundary enforcement required", Warning: true})
			}
		}
	}
	return diags, errors.Join(causes...)
}

func structZones() (z contracts.Zones) {
	z.Interface = []string{"api.txt"}
	z.Evals = []string{"evals/**"}
	z.Disposable = []string{"internal/**"}
	return
}

func doctorText(report checks.DoctorReport) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("checks=%+v diagnostics=%+v", report.Checks, report.Diagnostics)
}
func hasDoctorDiagnostic(report checks.DoctorReport, code string, warning bool, terms ...string) bool {
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		if d.Code != code || d.Warning != warning {
			continue
		}
		ok := true
		for _, s := range terms {
			if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message), strings.ToLower(s)) {
				ok = false
			}
		}
		if ok {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func hasDoctorCheck(report checks.DoctorReport, name string, passed bool) bool {
	for _, c := range report.Checks {
		if strings.Contains(c.Name, name) && c.Passed == passed {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func doctorErrors(report checks.DoctorReport) bool {
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		if !d.Warning {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func assertScratchRemoved(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture) {
	t.Helper()
	common := strings.TrimSpace(f.git("rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"))
	if !filepath.IsAbs(common) {
		common = filepath.Join(f.root, common)
	}
	common, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(common)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	base := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees")
	for _, line := range strings.Split(doctorLog(f), "\n") {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "setup:") {
			continue
		}
		path := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "setup:")
		for parent := path; ; parent = filepath.Dir(parent) {
			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(parent)
			if err == nil {
				suffix, err := filepath.Rel(parent, path)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				path = filepath.Join(resolved, suffix)
				break
			}
			if parent == filepath.Dir(parent) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(base, path)
		if err != nil || rel == "." || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
			t.Errorf("scratch %q is not below common Git directory %q", path, base)
		}
		if _, err := os.Stat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Errorf("physical scratch directory %q remains or cannot be checked: %v", path, err)
		}
		return
	}
	t.Error("setup did not record a scratch path")
}

	want := project.Check(f.root)
	if len(want) == 0 || !doctorErrors(checks.DoctorReport{Diagnostics: want}) {
		t.Fatal("fixture has no static diagnostic")
	}
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
	remaining := map[project.Diagnostic]int{}
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		remaining[d]++
	}
	for _, d := range want {
		if remaining[d] == 0 {
			t.Errorf("complete project diagnostic %+v lost: %s", d, doctorText(report))
		}
		remaining[d]--
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "setup:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "eval:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "boundaries:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "worker:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "audit:") {
		t.Errorf("static error ran probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
}

	for _, d := range project.Check(f.root) {
		if !d.Warning {
			t.Fatalf("invalid Go doctor fixture: %+v", d)
		}
	}
	beforeStatus, beforeWorktrees := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if doctorErrors(report) {
		t.Errorf("real Go recipe doctor failed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"baseline", "undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id", "recovery"} {
		if !hasDoctorCheck(report, name, true) {
			t.Errorf("missing passing %s outcome: %s", name, doctorText(report))
		}
	}
	recoveries := 0
	for _, check := range report.Checks {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(check.Name), "recovery") && check.Passed {
			recoveries++
		}
	}
	if recoveries < 4 {
		t.Errorf("clean recovery not reported after each canary: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	modules := map[string]bool{}
	for _, check := range report.Checks {
		if check.Module != "" && check.Module != "alpha" {
			modules[check.Module] = true
		}
	}
	if len(modules) < 2 {
		t.Errorf("two distinct throwaway modules absent: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "setup:") || !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "/fireweed/worktrees/") {
		t.Errorf("setup did not run in scratch: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "worker:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "audit:") {
		t.Errorf("NoAgent ran agents: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	if got := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"); got != beforeStatus {
		t.Errorf("caller changed: before %q after %q", beforeStatus, got)
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != beforeWorktrees {
		t.Errorf("scratch registration leaked: before %q after %q", beforeWorktrees, got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
}

func Test_CHK_053_NestedModuleTemplatesRenderForBothCanaries(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put("go.mod", "module example.test/doctorfixture\n\ngo 1.23\n")
	fields := "{{name}}|{{prefix}}|{{package}}|{{go_module}}|{{module_dir}}|{{other_dir}}\n"
	f.put(".fireweed/templates/module/evals/nested.txt.tmpl", "eval|"+fields)
	f.put(".fireweed/templates/module/internal/nested.txt", "internal|"+fields)
	canaries := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml")))
	f.put(".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", strings.Replace(canaries, "undeclared:\n", "  evals/baseline.txt: \"baseline|"+strings.TrimSpace(fields)+"\"\nundeclared:\n", 1))
	eval := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, ".fireweed/eval.sh")))
	check := fmt.Sprintf(`case "$1" in
  doctor*)
    prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
    other=
    for spec in packages/*/SPEC.md; do
      dir=${spec%%/SPEC.md}
      case "$dir" in packages/alpha|"$2") ;; *) other=$dir ;; esac
    done
    expected="$1|$prefix|$1|example.test/doctorfixture|$2|$other"
    test -n "$other" &&
      test "$(cat "$2/evals/nested.txt")" = "eval|$expected" &&
      test "$(cat "$2/internal/nested.txt")" = "internal|$expected" &&
      test "$(cat "$2/evals/baseline.txt")" = "baseline|$expected" &&
      test ! -e "$2/evals/nested.txt.tmpl" || exit 17
    printf 'rendered:%%s\n' "$1" >> %q
    ;;
esac
`, f.log)
	f.put(".fireweed/eval.sh", strings.Replace(eval, "#!/bin/sh\n", "#!/bin/sh\n"+check, 1))
	f.commit()
	before := worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if doctorErrors(report) {
		t.Errorf("nested template probes failed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"baseline", "undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id", "recovery"} {
		if !hasDoctorCheck(report, name, true) {
			t.Errorf("missing passing %s probe: %s", name, doctorText(report))
		}
	}
	modules := map[string]bool{}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(doctorLog(f), "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "rendered:") {
			modules[strings.TrimPrefix(line, "rendered:")] = true
		}
	}
	if len(modules) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("expected both throwaway modules to pass nested template checks, got %v: %s", modules, doctorText(report))
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("scratch registration leaked: before %q after %q", before, got)
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "setup:") {
		assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_051_CancellationCleansScratchAndStopsSetupGroup(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	ready := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ready")
	childFinished := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "child-finished")
	f.put(".fireweed/setup.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/sh
printf 'setup:%%s\n' "$PWD" >> %q
sh -c 'sleep 2; printf finished > "$1"' sh %q &
printf ready > %q
wait
`, f.log, childFinished, ready))
	f.commit()
	before := worktrees(f)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	reports := make(chan checks.DoctorReport, 1)
	go func() { reports <- checks.Doctor(ctx, f.request(true)) }()
	deadline := time.After(8 * time.Second)
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(ready); err == nil {
			break
		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		select {
		case report := <-reports:
			t.Fatalf("setup exited before cancellation: %s", doctorText(report))
		case <-deadline:
			t.Fatal("setup never signalled readiness")
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
	cancel()
	select {
	case report := <-reports:
		if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, "setup") {
			t.Errorf("cancelled setup lacked C14: %s", doctorText(report))
		}
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("cancelled doctor did not return promptly")
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("cancelled doctor retained Git registration: before %q after %q", before, got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
	time.Sleep(2200 * time.Millisecond)
	if _, err := os.Stat(childFinished); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("cancelled setup descendant continued: %v", err)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_054_MissingTemplatesAndCanaryMaps(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, path, body, term, input, affected string }{
		{"missing template", ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "", "template", "SPEC.md", "undeclared"},
		{"malformed template", ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "---\nname: [broken\nid_prefix: {{prefix}}\n---\n", "template", "SPEC.md", "undeclared"},
		{"missing baseline", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: 1\nbaseline: {}\n", "canary", "baseline", "undeclared"},
		{"missing internal_eval", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "missing_id:\n  evals/missing.txt: missing\n", "internal_eval", "internal_eval", "internal_eval"},
		{"wrong version", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: 2\nbaseline: {}\n", "canary", "canaries.yaml", "undeclared"},
		{"malformed canary", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: [bad\n", "canary", "canaries.yaml", "undeclared"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			if tc.name == "missing baseline" {
				body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)))
				start, end := strings.Index(body, "baseline:\n"), strings.Index(body, "undeclared:\n")
				if start < 0 || end <= start {
					t.Fatal("fixture cannot isolate baseline map")
				}
				tc.body = body[:start] + "baseline: {}\n" + body[end:]
			}
			if tc.name == "missing internal_eval" {
				body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)))
				tc.body = strings.Replace(body, "internal_eval:\n  internal/private.txt: \"private\"\n  evals/internal.txt: \"{{module_dir}}\"\n", "", 1)
				if tc.body == body {
					t.Fatal("fixture did not remove internal_eval map")
				}
			}
			if tc.body == "" {
				if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			} else {
				f.put(tc.path, tc.body)
			}
			f.commit()
			report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, tc.term) {
				t.Errorf("missing C14: %s", doctorText(report))
			}
			identified := false
			for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
				if d.Code == "C14" && !d.Warning && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message+" "+d.Path), strings.ToLower(tc.input)) {
					identified = true
				}
			}
			if !identified {
				t.Errorf("C14 did not identify %s: %s", tc.input, doctorText(report))
			}
			if hasDoctorCheck(report, tc.affected, true) {
				t.Errorf("invalid recipe passed canary: %s", doctorText(report))
			}
		})
	}
}

	cmd := exec.Command("go", "build", "-o", bin, ".")

	}
